lines.zh: 做得好，孩子们！看！他有一张红嘴巴。

lines.en: Now, he has got a long nose.
lines.zh: 现在，他有了一个长鼻子。

lines.en: Oh, he hasn't got eyes.
lines.zh: 哦，他还没有眼睛。

lines.en: I've got two rocks!
lines.zh: 我有两块石头！

lines.en: Now he has got two eyes.
lines.zh: 现在他有两只眼睛了。

lines.en: He's got long arms and big hands!
lines.zh: 他有长长的胳膊和大大的手！

lines.en: Wow! You've got a cool snowman!
lines.zh: 哇！你们堆了一个很酷的雪人！

title: Speed up 故事 The best body part
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U2 Speed up (The best body part)

lines.en: Hello, who is there?
lines.zh: 你好，是谁在那里？

lines.en: I'm the best!
lines.zh: 我是最棒的！

lines.en: No, I'm the best!
lines.zh: 不，我才是最棒的！

lines.en: Sorry, Nana. We are your body parts. Who is the best for you?
lines.zh: 对不起，娜娜。我们是你的身体部位。谁对你来说最棒呢？

lines.en: You've got two ears. We help you hear.
lines.zh: 你有两只耳朵。我们帮你听。

lines.en: You've got two eyes. We help you see.
lines.zh: 你有两只眼睛。我们帮你看。

lines.en: I help you talk and eat.
lines.zh: 我帮你说话和吃东西。

lines.en: I help you smell.
lines.zh: 我帮你闻气味。

lines.en: And me... And me...
lines.zh: 还有我……还有我……

lines.en: Hey! Please stop! You are all important to me. You are a team.
lines.zh: 嘿！请停下！你们对我来说都很重要。你们是一个团队。

lines.en: You're right! Let's work together for Nana!
lines.zh: 你说得对！让我们一起为娜娜出力吧！

title: Fuel up Listen and chant 不同的面孔
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U2 Fuel up (Listen and chant)

lines.en: I have got black hair.
lines.zh: 我有黑头发。

lines.en: You have got brown hair.
lines.zh: 你有棕头发。

lines.en: I have got black eyes.
lines.zh: 我有黑眼睛。

lines.en: You have got blue eyes.
lines.zh: 你有蓝眼睛。

lines.en: I have got a small nose.
lines.zh: 我有一个小鼻子。

lines.en: You have got a big nose.
lines.zh: 你有一个大鼻子。

lines.en: We have got different faces.
lines.zh: 我们有不同的面孔。

lines.en: But that's not important.
lines.zh: 但那并不重要。

lines.en: Let's be friends!
lines.zh: 让我们做朋友吧！

title: In focus 喜好问答
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U3 In focus（U3 Start up页为图片版式，文字版PDF未提取到，故用In focus真实句）

lines.en: Do you like it?
lines.zh: 你喜欢它吗？

lines.en: I like cucumbers.
lines.zh: 我喜欢黄瓜。

lines.en: I don't like beans.
lines.zh: 我不喜欢豆子。

lines.en: He likes grapes.
lines.zh: 他喜欢葡萄。

lines.en: Yes, I do.
lines.zh: 是的，我喜欢。

lines.en: Hi, Xiaolei. Do you like oranges?
lines.zh: 嗨，小雷。你喜欢橙子吗？

lines.en: No, I don't. I like apples.
lines.zh: 不，我不喜欢。我喜欢苹果。

title: Speed up 故事 Breakfast on the farm
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U3 Speed up (Breakfast on the farm)

lines.en: Hello, Grandma. Hello, Grandpa.
lines.zh: 你好，奶奶。你好，爷爷。

lines.en: Hello, Taotao and Jiajia.
lines.zh: 你们好，涛涛和佳佳。

lines.en: Time to get up, children. But it's still early.
lines.zh: 该起床了，孩子们。可是天还早。

lines.en: Let's get ready for breakfast.
lines.zh: 我们准备吃早饭吧。

lines.en: Do you like eggs? Yes, we do. Now we've got eggs.
lines.zh: 你们喜欢鸡蛋吗？是的，我们喜欢。现在我们有鸡蛋了。

lines.en: Do you like tomatoes? Yes, we do. Now we've got tomatoes.
lines.zh: 你们喜欢西红柿吗？是的，我们喜欢。现在我们有西红柿了。

lines.en: Do you like corn? Yes, I do. Now we've got corn.
lines.zh: 你喜欢玉米吗？是的，我喜欢。现在我们有玉米了。

lines.en: Do you like apples? No, I don't. I like grapes.
lines.zh: 你喜欢苹果吗？不，我不喜欢。我喜欢葡萄。

lines.en: OK. Let's get grapes.
lines.zh: 好的。我们去摘葡萄吧。

lines.en: Thank you, Grandma and Grandpa.
lines.zh: 谢谢爷爷奶奶。

lines.en: Yummy! Let's get ready for lunch together, too!
lines.zh: 真好吃！我们也一起准备午饭吧！

title: Fuel up Listen and chant Afternoon tea
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U3 Fuel up (Listen and chant)

lines.en: Every week, under the tree,
lines.zh: 每个星期，在树下，

lines.en: A nice afternoon tea
lines.zh: 一顿美好的下午茶，

lines.en: For Grandpa and me!
lines.zh: 给爷爷和我！

lines.en: Milk tea is good.
lines.zh: 奶茶真好。

lines.en: Cupcakes are great.
lines.zh: 纸杯蛋糕很棒。

lines.en: Yummy sandwiches,
lines.zh: 美味的三明治，

lines.en: With beef and eggs!
lines.zh: 夹着牛肉和鸡蛋！

title: Start up 主对话 大明的家庭照片
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U4 Start up

lines.en: What are these?
lines.zh: 这些是什么？

lines.en: Photos of my family.
lines.zh: 我家人的照片。

lines.en: Who is this?
lines.zh: 这是谁？

lines.en: That's my mum. She likes writing.
lines.zh: 那是我妈妈。她喜欢写作。

lines.en: Who is this?
lines.zh: 这是谁？

lines.en: That's my dad. He likes running.
lines.zh: 那是我爸爸。他喜欢跑步。

lines.en: They are your grandpa and grandma.
lines.zh: 他们是你的爷爷和奶奶。

lines.en: Yes, they like doing tai chi.
lines.zh: 是的，他们喜欢打太极。

lines.en: What do you like doing, Daming?
lines.zh: 你喜欢做什么，大明？

lines.en: I like taking photos!
lines.zh: 我喜欢拍照！

title: Speed up 故事 Fabre the insect man
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U4 Speed up (Fabre the insect man)

lines.en: This is Fabre. He likes learning about animals and plants.
lines.zh: 这是法布尔。他喜欢了解动植物。

lines.en: He likes asking questions.
lines.zh: 他喜欢提问题。

lines.en: He likes watching insects.
lines.zh: 他喜欢观察昆虫。

lines.en: One day he goes up a tree to study a mantis.
lines.zh: 有一天，他爬上树去研究一只螳螂。

lines.en: He stays there and watches for a long time.
lines.zh: 他待在那里观察了很久。

lines.en: Hey! You! Why are you up there?
lines.zh: 嘿！你！你在上面干什么？

lines.en: I'm here to watch this mantis! Why? It's so interesting!
lines.zh: 我在这儿观察这只螳螂！为什么？它太有趣了！

lines.en: Fabre grows up. He writes many books about insects.
lines.zh: 法布尔长大了。他写了许多关于昆虫的书。

lines.en: People like reading them!
lines.zh: 人们喜欢读这些书！

title: Fuel up Listen and chant Hobbies around the world
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U4 Fuel up (Listen and chant)

lines.en: From country to country,
lines.zh: 从一个国家到另一个国家，

lines.en: We have different hobbies.
lines.zh: 我们有不同的爱好。

lines.en: Stan likes making robots.
lines.zh: 斯坦喜欢做机器人。

lines.en: Rena likes cooking food.
lines.zh: 雷娜喜欢做饭。

lines.en: Weiwei likes making kites.
lines.zh: 伟伟喜欢做风筝。

lines.en: Sally likes skating on ice.
lines.zh: 萨莉喜欢滑冰。

lines.en: It's so much fun to play.
lines.zh: 玩起来真开心。

lines.en: It makes us happy.
lines.zh: 它让我们快乐。

title: Start up 主对话 Not now!
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U5 Start up (Not now!)

lines.en: It's half past six. It's time to get up.
lines.zh: 六点半了。该起床了。

lines.en: Not now.
lines.zh: 现在不去。

lines.en: Come on, Sam! It's time for school!
lines.zh: 快点，萨姆！该上学了！

lines.en: Urgh... Not now.
lines.zh: 呃……现在不去。

lines.en: It's time to do your homework, Sam.
lines.zh: 该做作业了，萨姆。

lines.en: Not now!
lines.zh: 现在不去！

lines.en: Time to go to bed, Sam.
lines.zh: 该上床睡觉了，萨姆。

lines.en: What time is it? It's only six o'clock. Not now.
lines.zh: 几点了？才六点钟。现在不去。

title: Speed up 故事 Yuanyuan and her mum's day
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U5 Speed up (Yuanyuan and her mum's day)

lines.en: It's six o'clock in the morning. Yuanyuan gets up. Her mum is at work.
lines.zh: 早上六点。圆圆起床。她妈妈在上班。

lines.en: It's seven o'clock in the morning. Yuanyuan goes to school. Her mum goes home.
lines.zh: 早上七点。圆圆去上学。她妈妈回家。

lines.en: It's half past eight in the morning. Yuanyuan has classes at school. Her mum goes to bed.
lines.zh: 早上八点半。圆圆在学校上课。她妈妈上床睡觉。

lines.en: It's five o'clock in the afternoon. Yuanyuan goes home. Her mum goes to work.
lines.zh: 下午五点。圆圆回家。她妈妈去上班。

lines.en: It's nine o'clock in the evening. Yuanyuan goes to bed. Her mum is at work.
lines.zh: 晚上九点。圆圆上床睡觉。她妈妈在上班。

title: Fuel up Listen and chant 时差 Toby and Danny
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U5 Fuel up + U5听力脚本交叉校对

lines.en: Toby Tiger calls Danny Dog. Why, oh why?
lines.zh: 托比老虎给丹尼狗打电话。哎呀，为什么呢？

lines.en: Good morning. It's time to get up.
lines.zh: 早上好。该起床了。

lines.en: Toby's in London and Danny's in Sydney.
lines.zh: 托比在伦敦，丹尼在悉尼。

lines.en: It's only 9 am for Toby.
lines.zh: 对托比来说才早上九点。

lines.en: But it's 6 pm for Danny.
lines.zh: 可是对丹尼来说已经下午六点了。

lines.en: Good evening. It's time to have dinner.
lines.zh: 晚上好。该吃晚饭了。

title: Start up 主对话 We have art on Friday
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U6 Start up (We have art on Friday)

lines.en: It's Wednesday. Only two days!
lines.zh: 今天星期三。只剩两天了！

lines.en: It's Thursday! Only one day!
lines.zh: 今天星期四！只剩一天了！

lines.en: You're happy! Why?
lines.zh: 你好开心！为什么？

lines.en: It's Friday! We have art on Friday. We love art!
lines.zh: 今天星期五！我们星期五有美术课。我们喜欢美术！

lines.en: Sorry, everyone. Ms Li is not well today.
lines.zh: 对不起，各位。李老师今天不舒服。

lines.en: Oh... No art today!
lines.zh: 哦……今天没有美术课了！

lines.en: Let's do something for Ms Li.
lines.zh: 我们为李老师做点什么吧。

lines.en: Good idea!
lines.zh: 好主意！

lines.en: Get well soon!
lines.zh: 早日康复！

title: Speed up 故事 A busy week
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U6 Speed up (A busy week)

lines.en: It's Monday. Let's go and visit our old friends this Sunday! Great!
lines.zh: 星期一。我们这个星期天去看望老朋友吧！好极了！

lines.en: It's Tuesday. I want to make some bookmarks for Grandma Guo. She likes reading.
lines.zh: 星期二。我想给郭奶奶做一些书签。她喜欢读书。

lines.en: It's Wednesday. I want to make a stick for Grandpa Liu.
lines.zh: 星期三。我想给刘爷爷做一根拐杖。

lines.en: It's Thursday. What about a painting for Grandma Zhang?
lines.zh: 星期四。给张奶奶画一幅画怎么样？

lines.en: It's Friday. Dad, I want some tea. It's for Grandpa Ma. Sure.
lines.zh: 星期五。爸爸，我想要些茶叶。这是给马爷爷的。好的。

lines.en: It's Saturday. Mum, I want some flowers for Grandma Yang. Sure.
lines.zh: 星期六。妈妈，我想给杨奶奶买些花。好的。

lines.en: It's Sunday. Thank you so much, Wenwen!
lines.zh: 星期天。太谢谢你了，雯雯！

title: Fuel up Listen and chant After-school clubs
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三起）；三下教材PDF U6 Fuel up (Listen and chant)

lines.en: Piano club and painting club!
lines.zh: 钢琴俱乐部和绘画俱乐部！

lines.en: Book club and basketball club!
lines.zh: 读书俱乐部和篮球俱乐部！

lines.en: From Monday to Friday,
lines.zh: 从星期一到星期五，

lines.en: Come, learn and play!
lines.zh: 来学习，来玩耍！

lines.en: Singing club and dance club!
lines.zh: 唱歌俱乐部和舞蹈俱乐部！

lines.en: Computer club and football club!
lines.zh: 电脑俱乐部和足球俱乐部！

lines.en: From Monday to Friday,
lines.zh: 从星期一到星期五，

lines.en: Come, learn and play!
lines.zh: 来学习，来玩耍！

title: Start up · Read and answer（我会做什么）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U1 Start up（Read and answer）

lines.en: —Can you jump high, Daming?
lines.zh: ——大明，你能跳得高吗？

lines.en: —Yes, I can.
lines.zh: ——是的，我能。

lines.en: —Can you run fast?
lines.zh: ——你能跑得快吗？

lines.en: —Yes, I can!
lines.zh: ——是的，我能！

lines.en: —Can you play ping-pong?
lines.zh: ——你会打乒乓球吗？

lines.en: —Yes, I can.
lines.zh: ——是的，我会。

lines.en: —Can you swim?
lines.zh: ——你会游泳吗？

lines.en: —No, I can't. But I can learn. I can swim now.
lines.zh: ——不，我不会。但我可以学。我现在会游泳了。

lines.en: —Wow! You can swim fast!
lines.zh: ——哇！你游得真快！

title: Speed up · Read and answer（特里·福克斯横穿加拿大）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U1 Speed up（Read and answer）

lines.en: I'm Terry Fox. I like running and playing basketball. But I lose one leg because of cancer. Can I help other people with cancer? I know! I can run across Canada. And I can get money for the people! It's hard for me. Many kind people help me.
lines.zh: 我是特里·福克斯。我喜欢跑步和打篮球。但是因为癌症，我失去了一条腿。我能帮助其他癌症患者吗？我想到了！我可以跑步横穿加拿大，而且我可以为他们筹集资金！这对我来说很难，很多善良的人帮助我。

title: Fuel up · Listen and chant（运动会歌谣）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U1 Fuel up（Listen and chant）

lines.en: Welcome to Sports Day! Sports Day! Sports Day! Come on, everybody!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到运动会！运动会！运动会！大家加油！

lines.en: I can't run very fast. I can't jump very far. It's OK. It's OK.
lines.zh: 我跑得不是很快，我跳得不是很远。没关系，没关系。

lines.en: It's OK to fail. Don't give up! Never stop! Work hard and try your best!
lines.zh: 失败也没关系。不要放弃！永不停止！努力并尽你最大的努力！

title: Start up · Read and answer（萨姆与博比收拾房间）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U2 Start up（Read and answer）

lines.en: Dad: Sam, may I play outside?
lines.zh: 爸爸：萨姆，我可以出去玩吗？

lines.en: Dad: Yes. But can you tidy your room first?
lines.zh: 爸爸：可以。但是你能先整理一下你的房间吗？

lines.en: Sam: OK. That's easy.
lines.zh: 萨姆：好的。那很容易。

lines.en: Dad: Bobby, can you help me clean the floor?
lines.zh: 爸爸：博比，你能帮我打扫地板吗？

lines.en: Bobby: Woof! Woof!
lines.zh: 博比：汪汪！汪汪！

lines.en: Dad: Go, Bobby! Good job!
lines.zh: 爸爸：去吧，博比！干得好！

lines.en: Dad: Bobby, stop! Look! It's so dirty now! Woof! Woof!
lines.zh: 爸爸：博比，停下！看！现在太脏了！汪汪！汪汪！

lines.en: Dad: Sam, are you still busy?
lines.zh: 爸爸：萨姆，你还在忙吗？

lines.en: Sam: Yes, Dad. I need to clean the floor, the desk and the wall.
lines.zh: 萨姆：是的，爸爸。我需要打扫地板、书桌和墙壁。

title: Speed up · Read and answer（姚沁雯照顾家人）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U2 Speed up（Read and answer）

lines.en: I'm Yao Qinwen. This is my family. My dad is ill. My grandma is old. My mum is busy. I must help!
lines.zh: 我是姚沁雯。这是我的家人。我爸爸生病了。我奶奶年纪大了。我妈妈很忙。我必须帮忙！

lines.en: I take care of Dad. —Can I make the bed for you, Dad? —Thank you, Wenwen.
lines.zh: 我照顾爸爸。——爸爸，我可以帮你铺床吗？——谢谢你，雯雯。

lines.en: I take care of Grandma. —Wenwen, can you help clean the room? —Sure!
lines.zh: 我照顾奶奶。——雯雯，你能帮忙打扫房间吗？——当然可以！

lines.en: Sometimes Mum feels tired. I take care of her, too. —May I help you wash the dishes, Mum? —Thank you, my dear!
lines.zh: 有时候妈妈觉得很累，我也会照顾她。——我可以帮妈妈洗碗吗？——谢谢，亲爱的！

lines.en: Wenwen is so helpful. She is the sunshine of our family. I'm happy to warm up my family.
lines.zh: 雯雯很懂事、很会帮忙。她是我们家的阳光。我很高兴能温暖我的家人。

title: Fuel up · Listen and chant（家里的好帮手歌谣）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U2 Fuel up（Listen and chant）

lines.en: Dad and Mum work hard on the farm. Together we help around the house.
lines.zh: 爸爸妈妈在农场辛勤劳作。我们一起在家里帮忙。

lines.en: Water the vegetables. Sweep the yard. Feed the chickens. And wash up.
lines.zh: 给蔬菜浇水。打扫院子。喂鸡。还有洗碗。

lines.en: You and me, let's work hard. We're good helpers to Mum and Dad.
lines.zh: 你和我，让我们努力干活。我们是爸爸妈妈的好帮手。

title: Start up · Read and answer（天气变了，我们的“雨伞”）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U3 Start up（Read and answer）

lines.en: What's the weather like? It's sunny and warm. We can go out to play. Oh, it's cool!
lines.zh: 天气怎么样？阳光明媚，很暖和。我们可以出去玩。哦，有点凉爽！

lines.en: It's windy and cloudy. Let's go home! Oh! It's rainy now. Let's run!
lines.zh: 有风，天阴了。我们回家吧！哦！现在下雨了。我们快跑！

lines.en: Look! I've got a good idea. Our umbrellas are great!
lines.zh: 看！我有个好主意。我们的“雨伞”真棒！

lines.en: Look! Let's go and help! Thank you.
lines.zh: 看！我们去帮忙吧！谢谢。

title: Speed up · Read and answer（三亚孩子们看到真雪）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U3 Speed up（Read and answer）

lines.en: Liu Fei is a teacher at a children's home in Sanya. Liu Fei calls her friend Lin Jia in Harbin.
lines.zh: 刘菲是三亚一家儿童福利院的老师。刘菲给她在哈尔滨的朋友林佳打电话。

lines.en: —Hey, what's the weather like there today? —It's snowy and cold.
lines.zh: ——嘿，你那里今天天气怎么样？——又下雪又冷。

lines.en: Does it taste like ice cream? What is snow like?
lines.zh: 雪吃起来像冰淇淋吗？雪是什么样的？

lines.en: The children here want to see real snow. But it's hot in Sanya. It never snows!
lines.zh: 这里的孩子们想看真正的雪。但是三亚很热，从来不下雪！

lines.en: Two days later, Liu Fei gets a big surprise. Liu Fei takes the snow to the children's home.
lines.zh: 两天后，刘菲得到了一个大惊喜。刘菲把雪带到了儿童之家。

lines.en: Look! Real snow! It's cool! Hooray!
lines.zh: 看！真的雪！真酷！万岁！

title: Fuel up · Listen and chant（看天气预报歌谣）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U3 Fuel up（Listen and chant）

lines.en: What's the weather like today? Is it cold or hot? Do I need my coat or not?
lines.zh: 今天天气怎么样？是冷还是热？我需不需要穿外套呢？

lines.en: What's the weather like today? Is it rainy or sunny? Can we have some fun outside?
lines.zh: 今天天气怎么样？是下雨还是晴天？我们能出去玩吗？

lines.en: What's the weather like today? Come on, let's turn on the TV. Let's watch the report today!
lines.zh: 今天天气怎么样？来吧，我们打开电视，今天让我们看看天气预报！

title: Start up · Read and answer（你最喜欢的季节）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U4 Start up（Read and answer）

lines.en: What's your favourite season, friends? I like winter best. I can play in the snow.
lines.zh: 朋友们，你们最喜欢的季节是什么？我最喜欢冬天。我可以在雪地里玩耍。

lines.en: I don't like winter. It's cold. I like spring and autumn. They are beautiful.
lines.zh: 我不喜欢冬天。冬天很冷。我喜欢春天和秋天。它们很美。

lines.en: I like summer best. I can eat ice cream. What about you, Lingling? I like summer best, too.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢夏天。我可以吃冰淇淋。玲玲，你呢？我也最喜欢夏天。

lines.en: —Why do you also like summer? —Because my birthday is in summer! Ha ha!
lines.zh: ——你为什么也喜欢夏天？——因为我的生日在夏天！哈哈！

title: Speed up · Read and answer（李涵的苹果树四季）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U4 Speed up（Read and answer）

lines.en: I'm Li Han. This is my apple tree. I'm ten now. The tree is ten, too.
lines.zh: 我是李涵。这是我的苹果树。我现在十岁了，这棵树也十岁了。

lines.en: Spring is here. The birds are back.
lines.zh: 春天到了，鸟儿回来了。

lines.en: It's summer. The apple tree is like a sun umbrella. I like reading under it. —Can I share the apples with my friends? —Sure!
lines.zh: 夏天到了，苹果树就像一把太阳伞。我喜欢在它下面看书。——我可以和朋友们分享这些苹果吗？——当然可以！

lines.en: It's autumn. I like autumn best. There are many red apples on the tree!
lines.zh: 秋天到了。我最喜欢秋天。树上有许多红苹果！

lines.en: It's winter. My apple tree has warm, new clothes! A snowstorm comes. Oh, no! My apple tree! I don't like winter!
lines.zh: 冬天到了。我的苹果树穿上了温暖的新“衣服”！暴风雪来了。哦，不！我的苹果树！我不喜欢冬天！

lines.en: Don't worry. Let's wait for spring. It's spring again. My apple tree grows again.
lines.zh: 别担心，让我们等待春天。又是春天了，我的苹果树又开始生长了。

title: Fuel up · Listen and chant（世界各地的季节歌谣）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U4 Fuel up（Listen and chant）

lines.en: Up here it's summer. Go to the beach. Jump in the sea!
lines.zh: 这里是夏天。去海滩吧，跳进海里！

lines.en: On the equator, there is no winter. It's a hot, hot summer, all year round.
lines.zh: 在赤道上，没有冬天，这里终年都是炎热的夏天。

lines.en: Down here it's winter. The weather's quite cold. Join us and play!
lines.zh: 这里是冬天，天气非常寒冷，来和我们一起玩吧！

title: Start up · Read and answer（去公园野餐，绿色出行）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U5 Start up（Read and answer）

lines.en: —Let's go for a picnic in the park. —Hooray!
lines.zh: ——我们去公园野餐吧。——万岁！

lines.en: —How do we get there? —Let's go by car! It's fast!
lines.zh: ——我们怎么去那儿呢？——我们开车去吧！开车很快！

lines.en: —No, let's go in a 'green' way! —A green way?
lines.zh: ——不，我们用一种“绿色”的方式去吧！——“绿色”的方式？

lines.en: —Yes. Go and get ready. Let's meet in five minutes. We're green now! Let's go!
lines.zh: ——是的。去准备一下，我们五分钟后见。我们现在变“绿”啦！走吧！

lines.en: —Ha ha! Not that kind of green! This kind of green!
lines.zh: ——哈哈！不是那种绿色！是这种（环保）绿色！

title: Speed up · Read and answer（熊猫晶晶、思海搬家去卡塔尔）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U5 Speed up（Read and answer）

lines.en: Hello. I'm Jingjing. This is my friend Sihai. We live in Sichuan.
lines.zh: 你好，我是晶晶。这是我的朋友思海。我们住在四川。

lines.en: It's time to go to Qatar! But how do we get there? It's far away.
lines.zh: 现在要去卡塔尔了！但是怎么去呢？很远的。

lines.en: Look! The truck is here. Let's go! Goodbye, everyone!
lines.zh: 看！卡车来了。我们走吧！再见，大家！

lines.en: Now we are on a plane in the sky. Goodbye, China!
lines.zh: 现在我们在天空中的飞机上。再见，中国！

lines.en: What a long way! Here we are! Hello, Qatar! We go to our new home by truck.
lines.zh: 好长的一段路啊！我们到了！你好，卡塔尔！我们乘卡车去我们的新家。

lines.en: It's our new home. It's big. We've got a lot of bamboo here. It comes from China by plane!
lines.zh: 这是我们的新家，它很大。这里有很多竹子，它们是从中国通过飞机运来的。

lines.en: Many people come to see us. We've got a lot of new friends! We are happy!
lines.zh: 很多人来看我们。我们交了很多新朋友！我们很高兴！

title: Fuel up · Listen and chant（交通方式歌谣）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U5 Fuel up（Listen and chant）

lines.en: Children, children, time for school! How do you go?
lines.zh: 孩子们，孩子们，上学时间到啦！你们怎么去呢？

lines.en: I go by bike. Ring, ring, ring.
lines.zh: 我骑自行车去。叮铃，叮铃，叮铃。

lines.en: She goes by bus. Beep, beep, beep.
lines.zh: 她坐公交车去。哔哔，哔哔，哔哔。

lines.en: He goes by subway. Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh.
lines.zh: 他坐地铁去。呼呼，呼呼，呼呼。

lines.en: They go by tram. Chug, chug, chug.
lines.zh: 他们坐有轨电车去。咔嚓，咔嚓，咔嚓。

title: Start up · Read and answer（小猫苏苏去哪儿了）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U6 Start up（Read and answer）

lines.en: My cat Susu goes out every morning! Where does she go? I don't know! Let's find out tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我的猫苏苏每天早上都会出去！她去哪儿了？我不知道！我们明天去找找看吧。

lines.en: Susu goes straight on to the museum. Then she turns left there.
lines.zh: 苏苏一直走到博物馆，然后在那里左转。

lines.en: At the hospital, she turns right. Then Susu stops. Let's go there!
lines.zh: 在医院那里右转，然后苏苏停下来了。我们也去那儿吧！

lines.en: Go straight on to the museum. Then, turn left. Turn right at the hospital.
lines.zh: 一直走到博物馆，然后左转，在医院那里右转。

lines.en: Susu, here you are! Your cat visits me every day. She's my good friend!
lines.zh: 苏苏，你在这儿！你的猫每天都来看我，她是我的好朋友！

title: Speed up · Read and answer（燕燕自己上学）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U6 Speed up（Read and answer）

lines.en: Yanyan can't see. She goes to school with her mum's help every day.
lines.zh: 燕燕看不见。她每天在妈妈的帮助下上学。

lines.en: —Mum, I'm 11 now. I want to go to school on my own!
lines.zh: ——妈妈，我现在11岁了，我想自己去上学！

lines.en: —Remember, go straight on, walk 50 steps... 48, 49, 50! Great! Cross the road. Turn left. The school is on your right.
lines.zh: ——记住，直走，走50步……48，49，50！太好了！过马路，向左转。学校在你的右边。

lines.en: —Mum, let me go to school on my own today! —Are you sure? —Yes, I can do it. One, two, three...
lines.zh: ——妈妈，今天让我自己去上学吧！——你确定吗？——是的，我可以做到。一，二，三……

lines.en: —Be careful, my girl! Go straight on... 48, 49, 50! OK. Cross the road and turn left.
lines.zh: ——小心点，我的女孩！直走……48，49，50！好，过马路，向左转。

lines.en: —I'm at school now, Mum! —Well done, Yanyan!
lines.zh: ——我现在在学校了，妈妈！——干得好，燕燕！

title: Fuel up · Listen and chant（在伦敦城里出行歌谣）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上课文docx U6 Fuel up（Listen and chant）

lines.en: This is London, with so many things to see. But how do we get around the city? Don't worry. It's easy!
lines.zh: 这是伦敦，有好多东西可以看。但我们要怎么在这座城市出行呢？别担心，这很简单！

lines.en: Walk to places near to here, and buses run from here to there.
lines.zh: 走到附近的地方，公交车从这里开到那里。

lines.en: There is a train. It goes underground. One, two, three. Let's go around.
lines.zh: 还有一列火车，它在地下行驶。一，二，三，我们四处逛逛吧。

title: Start up · 职业问答（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1第1课时整理（What does he do? / He is a scientist）

lines.en: A: Look at the man in the field. What does he do?
lines.zh: A：看田里那位男士。他是做什么的？

lines.en: B: He often works in the fields. Is he a farmer?
lines.zh: B：他经常在田里工作。他是农民吗？

lines.en: A: No, he isn't. Look at his brush. Is he a painter?
lines.zh: A：不，他不是。看他的画笔。他是画家吗？

lines.en: B: No, he isn't. Oh, look! He works in the lab. He is a scientist.
lines.zh: B：不，他不是。哦，看！他在实验室里工作。他是一名科学家。

lines.en: A: What does he do?
lines.zh: A：他是做什么的？

lines.en: B: He is a scientist. He helps people with his study.
lines.zh: B：他是一名科学家，他用自己的研究帮助人们。

title: Speed up · Night Workers 夜班工作者（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1第2课时整理（He/She works at night. They keep the city safe.）

lines.en: Some people work at night. A doctor works at night in the hospital. A nurse helps sick people at night. A driver drives the bus at night. A firefighter keeps us safe at night. They work when we sleep. They keep the city safe. They love their jobs. It feels great! We should say thank you to them.
lines.zh: 有些人在夜间工作。医生夜里在医院工作，护士夜里照顾病人，司机夜里开公交车，消防员夜里保护我们的安全。他们在我们睡觉的时候工作，他们保卫城市的安全。他们热爱自己的工作，感觉很棒！我们应该向他们说一声谢谢。

title: Fuel up · The Journey of Bread 面包之旅（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1第3课时整理（First... Then... Next... Finally...）

lines.en: How does bread come to our table? First, the farmer grows wheat. Then, the worker makes flour. Next, the baker bakes bread. Finally, the driver delivers it to the shop. Each job has a special role. Together, they make bread possible. Every job is important.
lines.zh: 面包是怎样来到我们餐桌上的？首先，农民种植小麦；然后，工人把小麦磨成面粉；接着，面包师烤出面包；最后，司机把它送到商店。每一份工作都有特别的作用，正是大家一起努力，才有了面包。每一份工作都很重要。

title: Start up · 今天感觉怎么样（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U2第1-2课时整理（I'm feeling... because... / How do you feel?）

lines.en: A: How do you feel today, Lingling?
lines.zh: A：玲玲，你今天感觉怎么样？

lines.en: B: I'm feeling sad. I feel sad because I can't sing in the show.
lines.zh: B：我感到难过。我难过是因为我不能参加表演唱歌了。

lines.en: A: Why are you sad?
lines.zh: A：你为什么难过？

lines.en: B: Because I have a cough. I'm ill.
lines.zh: B：因为我咳嗽了，我生病了。

lines.en: A: I'm sorry to hear that. You should see a doctor.
lines.zh: A：听到这个我很难过。你应该去看医生。

lines.en: B: I saw the doctor yesterday. Now I'm feeling better.
lines.zh: B：我昨天看过医生了，现在感觉好多了。

lines.en: A: What makes you happy?
lines.zh: A：什么让你开心？

lines.en: B: Playing with my friends makes me happy.
lines.zh: B：和朋友们一起玩让我开心。

title: Speed up · 六种情绪小故事（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U2第1-2课时整理（happy/sad/angry/excited/worried/surprised）

lines.en: Everyone has feelings. When we get a gift, we feel happy. When we lose a toy, we feel sad. When someone breaks our things, we feel angry. When a surprise party comes, we feel excited and surprised. When we have a test, we feel worried. We can talk about our feelings. —How do you feel? —I feel happy. Sharing feelings helps us feel better.
lines.zh: 每个人都有情绪。收到礼物时我们开心，弄丢玩具时我们难过，别人弄坏我们的东西时我们生气，惊喜派对到来时我们又惊喜又激动，要考试时我们感到担心。我们可以说出自己的情绪。——你感觉怎么样？——我很开心。把情绪说出来，我们会感觉好一些。

title: Fuel up · I feel...like... 情绪表达（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U2第4课时整理（I feel...like... / Why are you angry?）

lines.en: I feel like singing when I am happy. I feel like dancing when I am excited. I feel like crying when I am sad. Why are you angry? Because my brother broke my cup. Let's smile. A smile makes the day bright. Feelings are OK. We can talk, and then we feel better.
lines.zh: 开心时我想唱歌，激动时我想跳舞，难过时我想哭。你为什么生气？因为我弟弟打碎了我的杯子。让我们微笑吧，微笑让一天都明亮起来。有情绪很正常，说出来，我们就会好起来。

title: Start up · 你擅长什么（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U3第1课时整理（I can... / Why are you doing that? Because I love...）

lines.en: A: What are you doing, Lingling?
lines.zh: A：玲玲，你在做什么？

lines.en: B: I'm dancing. I'm good at dancing.
lines.zh: B：我在跳舞。我擅长跳舞。

lines.en: A: Is she good at dancing?
lines.zh: A：她擅长跳舞吗？

lines.en: B: Yes, she is. She dances very beautifully.
lines.zh: B：是的，她擅长，她跳得很美。

lines.en: A: What is that little chicken good at?
lines.zh: A：那只小鸡擅长什么？

lines.en: B: He's good at singing. He has a nice voice.
lines.zh: B：他擅长唱歌，嗓音很好听。

lines.en: A: Why are you doing that?
lines.zh: A：你为什么做这件事？

lines.en: B: Because I love dancing. I can dance well.
lines.zh: B：因为我热爱跳舞，我能跳得很好。

title: Speed up · I'm trying to... 不断尝试（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U3第2课时整理（I'm trying to... / Keep trying — that's real talent!）

lines.en: Everyone's got talent, but talent needs practice. I'm trying to fly the kite high. I'm trying to catch the ball. I'm trying to swim. Why? Because I want to be happy and grow. At first I may fail, but failure is part of learning. Keep trying — that's real talent!
lines.zh: 每个人都有才能，但才能需要练习。我在努力把风筝放高，我在努力接住球，我在努力游泳。为什么？因为我想快乐、想成长。起初我可能会失败，但失败是学习的一部分。不断尝试，这才是真正的才能！

title: Fuel up · I've got... talent 我的才能类型（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U3第3课时整理（I've got... talent: picture/word/body/number/musical）

lines.en: People have different kinds of talent. I've got picture talent — I love drawing. My friend has word talent — she writes well. He has body talent — he jumps high. She has number talent — she counts fast. The boy has musical talent — he sings well. What kind of talent do you have? Know your talents — that's the first step to growth!
lines.zh: 人们有不同类型的才能。我有绘画才能——我爱画画；我朋友有文字才能——她写得好；他有身体才能——跳得高；她有数字才能——算得快；那个男孩有音乐才能——唱得好。你有哪种才能？认识自己的才能，是成长的第一步！

title: Start up · 植物的组成部分（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U4第1课时整理（root/stem/leaf/flower/seed; What's this? It's a...）

lines.en: A: What's this?
lines.zh: A：这是什么？

lines.en: B: It's a root. The root holds the plant in the ground.
lines.zh: B：这是根。根把植物固定在土里。

lines.en: A: What's this?
lines.zh: A：这是什么？

lines.en: B: It's a stem. The stem is long and thin. It carries water up.
lines.zh: B：这是茎。茎又长又细，把水往上输送。

lines.en: A: Look! These are leaves.
lines.zh: A：看！这些是叶子。

lines.en: B: Yes. Its leaves are big and green. And this is a flower. It looks beautiful. We can also find a seed inside.
lines.zh: B：是的。它的叶子又大又绿。这是一朵花，看起来很漂亮。我们还能在里面找到一粒种子。

title: Speed up · 我们在种植（现在进行时）（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U4第2课时整理（We're planting seeds. / What are you doing? I'm...ing）

lines.en: Today we are in the garden. We're planting seeds. She's watering the flowers. They're digging in the soil. I'm putting the seed in the earth. What are you doing? I'm watering my pot. Seeds need water and sun every day. Take care, and the plant will grow.
lines.zh: 今天我们在花园里。我们在播种，她在浇花，他们在挖土。我正把种子放进土里。你在做什么？我在给我的花盆浇水。种子每天都需要水和阳光。用心照顾，植物就会生长。

title: Fuel up · 植物的用途（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U4第3-4课时整理（Plants are used to make... / 种植经历过去时+现在进行时）

lines.en: Plants are very useful. Plants are used to make paper. A cotton shirt comes from the cotton plant. A wooden chair comes from a tree. A bamboo basket comes from bamboo. We get food, clothes and medicine from plants. On Day 1, I planted seeds. Now my plant is growing. We should protect plants.
lines.zh: 植物非常有用。纸是用植物做的，棉衬衫来自棉花，木椅子来自树木，竹筐来自竹子。我们从植物获得食物、衣服和药。第一天我种下种子，现在我的植物正在生长。我们应该保护植物。

title: Start up · 学校活动与 There is/are（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U5第1课时整理（art festival/picnic/sports meeting/talent show; There is/are...）

lines.en: Our school has many events. There is an art festival. There are games at the school picnic. There is a sports meeting on the playground. There are trees in the tree-planting day. There is a talent show on the stage. There are many books in the reading corner. My favourite school event is the school picnic. There is a big tent and there are balloons.
lines.zh: 我们学校有很多活动。有一个艺术节，学校野餐会上有游戏，操场上有运动会，植树日有很多树，舞台上有才艺表演，阅读角有很多书。我最喜欢的学校活动是学校野餐。那里有一顶大帐篷，还有许多气球。

title: Speed up · Is there...? / Are there...? 观察提问（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U5第2-3课时整理（Is there...? / Are there...? 及答语）

lines.en: On the field trip, we look and ask. Is there a bird in the tree? Yes, there is. Are there any flowers on the ground? Yes, there are. Is there a small plant under the stone? No, there isn't. Are there any insects on the leaf? No, there aren't. We watch, ask and learn about nature.
lines.zh: 实地考察时，我们观察并提问。树上有鸟吗？是的，有。地上有花吗？是的，有。石头下面有小植物吗？不，没有。叶子上有昆虫吗？不，没有。我们观察、提问，了解大自然。

title: Fuel up · The Baby Bird's Homecoming 雏鸟回家（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U5第4课时整理（The Baby Bird's Homecoming 故事 + there be）

lines.en: Lanlan and Weiwei find a baby bird on the ground. It fell off the tree. There is no nest under it. They don't touch it. They call the teacher, and the forest keeper comes. Is there a mother bird near? Yes, she is waiting. The keeper puts the baby bird back into the nest. The mother bird comes back. It's a happy school event. We helped a little bird.
lines.zh: 兰兰和伟伟在地上发现一只雏鸟，它从树上掉了下来，下面没有巢。他们没有碰它，而是叫来老师，森林管理员赶来了。附近有鸟妈妈吗？是的，她在等着。管理员把雏鸟放回巢里，鸟妈妈回来了。这是一次开心的学校活动，我们帮助了一只小鸟。

title: Start up · 你穿什么（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U6第1课时整理（What are you wearing? I'm wearing...; dress/shirt/skirt/T-shirt/shorts/jacket/scarf）

lines.en: A: What are you wearing today, Daming?
lines.zh: A：大明，你今天穿什么？

lines.en: B: I'm wearing a T-shirt and shorts. It's hot today.
lines.zh: B：我穿了一件T恤衫和一条短裤。今天很热。

lines.en: A: But it's cold outside. You should wear a jacket and a scarf.
lines.zh: A：但外面很冷，你应该穿件夹克，戴条围巾。

lines.en: B: OK. I'm putting on my jacket now.
lines.zh: B：好的，我现在把夹克穿上。

lines.en: A: Lingling is wearing her favourite blue dress.
lines.zh: A：玲玲穿着她最喜欢的蓝连衣裙。

lines.en: B: It's pretty. Is it your favourite? Why?
lines.zh: B：真漂亮。这是你最喜欢的吗？为什么？

lines.en: A: Yes, because it's comfortable.
lines.zh: A：是的，因为它很舒服。

title: Speed up · 购物 What do you want?（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U6第2课时整理（What do you want? / I'd like a...; colour/size/material）

lines.en: A: What do you want?
lines.zh: A：你想要什么？

lines.en: B: I'd like a red skirt, please.
lines.zh: B：我想要一条红裙子。

lines.en: A: What about size and colour?
lines.zh: A：尺码和颜色呢？

lines.en: B: I'd like a blue sweater. It's warm.
lines.zh: B：我想要一件蓝毛衣，很暖和。

lines.en: A: Dad would like a new pair of shoes. He needs them for walking.
lines.zh: A：爸爸想要一双新鞋，他走路需要它。

lines.en: A: Mum would like a book about cooking. Clothes look nice when they fit well.
lines.zh: A：妈妈想要一本关于烹饪的书。合身的衣服看起来才好看。

title: Fuel up · Made of... 环保绿色时装（教案整理）
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U6第3-4课时整理（Made of... / Why? Because... / Reduce, Reuse, Recycle）

lines.en: We can make cool clothes from old things. My dress is made of an old black bag. My vest is made of old plastic bags. My hat is made of old paper. What is it made of? Why is it cool? Because we reuse old things and help the Earth. Reduce, reuse, recycle. My outfit is creative! Let's have a green fashion show.
lines.zh: 我们可以用旧东西做很酷的衣服。我的连衣裙用旧黑包做成，我的背心用旧塑料袋做成，我的帽子用旧纸做成。它是用什么做的？为什么很酷？因为我们重复利用旧物、保护地球。减少使用、重复利用、回收再利用。我的服装很有创意！我们办一场绿色时装秀吧。

title: Start up: Sam's vegetables（餐厅点餐）
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Start up U1 What's on your plate?

lines.en: Waiter: What do you want to eat?
lines.zh: 服务员：你想吃点什么？

lines.en: Sam: I want chicken and beef.
lines.zh: 萨姆：我想要鸡肉和牛肉。

lines.en: Amy: I want noodles in soup, salad and beef.
lines.zh: 艾米：我想要汤面、沙拉和牛肉。

lines.en: Boy: I like cake and cola.
lines.zh: 男孩：我喜欢蛋糕和可乐。

lines.en: Mum: Wow! There is so much food. Don't take too much! We should eat all the food on our plates.
lines.zh: 妈妈：哇！食物真多。别拿太多！我们应该把盘子里的食物都吃完。

lines.en: Mum: Sam, look at your plate. You should have some vegetables.
lines.zh: 妈妈：萨姆，看看你的盘子。你应该吃一些蔬菜。

lines.en: Sam: What vegetables have I got now? Potatoes, a lot of potatoes. OK. Let me go and get some.
lines.zh: 萨姆：我现在有什么蔬菜？土豆，好多土豆。好吧，我这就去拿点别的。

lines.en: Mum: Oh, Sam! Those are chips!
lines.zh: 妈妈：噢，萨姆！那些可是炸薯条！

title: Speed up: A letter from your stomach
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Speed up U1 What's on your plate?

lines.en: Dear Sally,
lines.zh: 亲爱的萨莉：

lines.en: That's enough! This is a bad day for me again!
lines.zh: 够了！对我来说，今天又是糟糕的一天！

lines.en: Every morning, you need a good breakfast. Let's have bread, milk, eggs, fruit and vegetables. Just a few biscuits are not enough! I often feel hungry all morning.
lines.zh: 每天早上，你需要一顿丰盛的早餐。我们吃面包、牛奶、鸡蛋、水果和蔬菜吧。只吃几块饼干是不够的！整个上午我都常常觉得饿。

lines.en: Then you often eat too much for lunch. You have a lot of meat, but no vegetables and no fruit. I get too heavy. This makes you sleepy in the afternoon.
lines.zh: 然后午饭你又常常吃得太多。你吃很多肉，却没有蔬菜，也没有水果。我变得太沉了，这让你下午犯困。

lines.en: And you always eat dinner too fast so you can go and play. You should eat slowly. I have to work hard for a long time after dinner. I'm so tired.
lines.zh: 而且你晚饭总是吃得太快，好去玩耍。你应该慢慢吃。晚饭后我得辛苦工作很长时间，我太累了。

lines.en: Sally, please make some changes. Help me stay healthy. Then you are healthy, too.
lines.zh: 萨莉，请做出一些改变吧。帮我保持健康，这样你自己也会健康。

lines.en: With love,
lines.zh: 爱你的，

lines.en: Your stomach
lines.zh: 你的胃

title: Fuel up: Go, slow, whoa!（饮食三档 chant）
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Fuel up U1 What's on your plate?

lines.en: Want to eat right? Remember three words: Go, slow, whoa!
lines.zh: 想吃得健康吗？记住三个词：畅吃、慢吃、停住！

lines.en: Tomatoes, grapes and oats? They help us to grow, So we can go, go, go!
lines.zh: 西红柿、葡萄和燕麦？它们帮我们长大，所以我们尽情吃、吃、吃！

lines.en: Biscuits, juice and nuts? Don't take too much. Be slow, slow, slow!
lines.zh: 饼干、果汁和坚果？别吃太多。要慢一点、慢一点、慢一点！

lines.en: Chips, candies and cakes? They make our body slow, So whoa! Say no!
lines.zh: 炸薯条、糖果和蛋糕？它们让身体变迟缓，所以停住吧！说不！

title: Start up: Wait and see（旧物改造做鸟窝）
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Start up U2 A green life

lines.en: Mum: The dress is too small for you.
lines.zh: 妈妈：这条连衣裙对你太小了。

lines.en: Amy: Mum, don't throw it away. I can make use of it.
lines.zh: 艾米：妈妈，别扔掉它。我能把它利用起来。

lines.en: Mum: OK. Take it. But what for?
lines.zh: 妈妈：好，拿去吧。但用来做什么呢？

lines.en: Amy: Wait and see!
lines.zh: 艾米：等着瞧！

lines.en: Daming: Grandpa, give those cans to me, please.
lines.zh: 大明：爷爷，请把那些罐子给我。

lines.en: Grandpa: Sure, but what for?
lines.zh: 爷爷：行，但做什么用？

lines.en: Daming: Wait and see!
lines.zh: 大明：等着瞧！

lines.en: Sam: Don't throw away that box, Dad! I want to use it.
lines.zh: 萨姆：爸爸，别扔掉那个盒子！我想用它。

lines.en: Dad: OK, you can keep it. But what for?
lines.zh: 爸爸：好，你留着吧。可做什么呢？

lines.en: Sam: Wait and see!
lines.zh: 萨姆：等着瞧！

lines.en: Lingling: Grandma, give that old shirt to me, please.
lines.zh: 玲玲：奶奶，请把那件旧衬衫给我。

lines.en: Grandma: No problem. But what for?
lines.zh: 奶奶：没问题。可做什么呢？

lines.en: Lingling: Wait and see!
lines.zh: 玲玲：等着瞧！

lines.en: Lingling: These are houses for birds. They're also places to keep them warm.
lines.zh: 玲玲：这些是给鸟儿做的房子，也是给它们保暖的地方。

lines.en: Sam: I love it! Now they have a better home!
lines.zh: 萨姆：我喜欢！现在它们有了更好的家！

title: Speed up: Milk box magic（牛奶盒回收三步）
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Speed up U2 A green life

lines.en: Dear all,
lines.zh: 各位同学：

lines.en: Each of us has a box of milk every day at school. We use over 150,000 milk boxes every year! But many of us just throw them away.
lines.zh: 我们每个人在学校每天都喝一盒牛奶。我们一年要用掉超过15万个牛奶盒！可很多人直接把它们扔掉。

lines.en: Milk boxes have three parts: paper, plastic and metal. Each part can turn into something new, like newspapers, bottles and cans.
lines.zh: 牛奶盒有三部分：纸、塑料和金属。每一部分都能变成新东西，比如报纸、瓶子和罐子。

lines.en: It is easy to recycle a milk box in just three steps:
lines.zh: 回收一个牛奶盒只要三步，很简单：

lines.en: 1. Open the milk box and wash it with water.
lines.zh: 1. 打开牛奶盒，用水冲洗干净。

lines.en: 2. Make it flat.
lines.zh: 2. 把它压平。

lines.en: 3. Put it into a recycling box.
lines.zh: 3. 放进回收箱。

lines.en: Now the milk box moves to a new beginning! Let's start now for a green world!
lines.zh: 现在，这个牛奶盒踏上了新的起点！为了一个绿色的世界，让我们从现在开始行动！

lines.en: Students from Class 502
lines.zh: 502班全体同学

title: 听力脚本 Activity 3: 自带购物袋
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上听力脚本U2（Activity 3）

lines.en: Cashier: That's 45 yuan. Would you like a plastic bag?
lines.zh: 收银员：一共45元。您要塑料袋吗？

lines.en: Daughter: Yes, please…
lines.zh: 女儿：好的，麻烦了……

lines.en: Mum: No, thanks. We have our own bag.
lines.zh: 妈妈：不用，谢谢。我们有自己的袋子。

lines.en: Daughter: Why do we bring our bag?
lines.zh: 女儿：我们为什么要带袋子？

lines.en: Mum: Because we shouldn't use too much plastic.
lines.zh: 妈妈：因为我们不应该用太多塑料。

lines.en: Daughter: But plastic makes our life easy.
lines.zh: 女儿：可是塑料让生活很方便呀。

lines.en: Mum: It is useful, but it is bad for the earth. For example, plastic in the sea can hurt many sea animals.
lines.zh: 妈妈：它有用，但对地球有害。比如，海里的塑料会伤害很多海洋动物。

lines.en: Daughter: That's bad. What other things can we do to cut down our use of plastic?
lines.zh: 女儿：那真糟糕。我们还能做些什么来减少塑料使用？

lines.en: Mum: We can always bring our own water bottles.
lines.zh: 妈妈：我们可以一直自带水杯。

lines.en: Daughter: I can do that!
lines.zh: 女儿：我能做到！

lines.en: Mum: Great. Remember, we should all take care of the earth.
lines.zh: 妈妈：很好。记住，我们都应该爱护地球。

title: Start up: Duoduo's best friends
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Start up U3 Happy together

lines.en: For Duoduo, Tutu is his best and only friend. He wants to play with Tutu, but Tutu is playing with two other boys. This makes Duoduo unhappy.
lines.zh: 对多多来说，图图是他最好也是唯一的朋友。他想和图图玩，可图图正和另外两个男孩一起玩。这让多多不开心。

lines.en: Tutu asks Duoduo to join them, but Duoduo just walks away.
lines.zh: 图图邀请多多加入他们，可多多只是走开了。

lines.en: After a week, Duoduo feels sad and he misses Tutu. "But Tutu may not miss me because he has new friends," Duoduo thinks.
lines.zh: 一周后，多多很难过，他想念图图。"可图图也许不想我，因为他有新朋友了，"多多想。

lines.en: Just then, Tutu sits down next to him. "Hi Duoduo. How are you?" Tutu asks.
lines.zh: 就在这时，图图坐到他旁边。"嗨，多多。你好吗？"图图问。

lines.en: "I'm unhappy because I'm not your friend now," answers Duoduo.
lines.zh: "我不开心，因为我现在不是你的朋友了，"多多回答。

lines.en: "Why do you say that?" says Tutu. "Yes, I have new friends, but you're still my friend. Old friends and new friends are both very nice. Join us and they can be your friends, too."
lines.zh: "你为什么这么说？"图图说。"是的，我有新朋友了，但你仍然是我的朋友。老朋友和新朋友都很好。加入我们吧，他们也能成为你的朋友。"

lines.en: Now Duoduo has three best friends!
lines.zh: 现在，多多有三个最好的朋友了！

title: Speed up: Friends with differences
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Speed up U3 Happy together

lines.en: Mum: Bird, you can't be friends with Dog because you're so different.
lines.zh: 妈妈：小鸟，你不能和小狗做朋友，因为你们太不一样了。

lines.en: Dad: Dog, you can't be friends with Bird because you're so different.
lines.zh: 爸爸：小狗，你不能和小鸟做朋友，因为你们太不一样了。

lines.en: Bird: Let's show them we aren't different. Then we can be friends.
lines.zh: 小鸟：我们来向他们证明我们并不不同，这样我们就能做朋友了。

lines.en: Dog: Good idea!
lines.zh: 小狗：好主意！

lines.en: Bird: I am small and you are big. I eat seeds and you eat meat. I fly and you run. Er, what do we share?
lines.zh: 小鸟：我很小，你很大。我吃种子，你吃肉。我会飞，你会跑。呃，我们到底有什么共同点呢？

lines.en: Rabbit: Hey, why are you looking worried?
lines.zh: 兔子：嘿，你为什么看起来发愁？

lines.en: Dog: We want to be friends but we can't. We are so different.
lines.zh: 小狗：我们想做朋友，可做不成。我们太不一样了。

lines.en: Rabbit: But we are friends because we are happy together. Friends play together and friends share with each other. That's the key.
lines.zh: 兔子：可我们就是朋友，因为我们在一起很快乐。朋友一起玩耍，朋友彼此分享。这才是关键。

lines.en: Bird & Dog: Let's show this to our parents. Then we can be friends — the best friends!
lines.zh: 小鸟和小狗：我们把这个讲给爸爸妈妈听。这样我们就能做朋友——最好的朋友！

title: 听力脚本 Activity 3: Sally 和 Mia 闹别扭
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上听力脚本U3（Activity 3）

lines.en: Mum: Sally, what's wrong? You look worried.
lines.zh: 妈妈：萨莉，怎么了？你看起来很发愁。

lines.en: Sally: It's Mia.
lines.zh: 萨莉：是米娅的事。

lines.en: Mum: Why? You are good friends.
lines.zh: 妈妈：怎么了？你们是好朋友呀。

lines.en: Sally: We have to work together on our science homework. I want to study sea animals. But Mia wants to study plastic. We can't change each other's ideas. So we get angry.
lines.zh: 萨莉：我们得一起做科学作业。我想研究海洋动物，可米娅想研究塑料。我们谁也说服不了谁，于是就生气了。

lines.en: Mum: Are you still angry?
lines.zh: 妈妈：你还在生气吗？

lines.en: Sally: No. But what should I do?
lines.zh: 萨莉：不了。可我该怎么办？

lines.en: Mum: First, go and say sorry to Mia. Say sorry first because friends should be nice to each other.
lines.zh: 妈妈：第一步，先去向米娅道歉。先道歉，因为朋友之间应该友好相待。

lines.en: Sally: OK. Then what?
lines.zh: 萨莉：好。然后呢？

lines.en: Mum: Next, have a talk with Mia. Friends should listen to each other. You can find the right plan for the homework.
lines.zh: 妈妈：接着，和米娅好好谈一谈。朋友应该互相倾听。你们能找到合适的作业方案。

lines.en: Sally: Thank you, Mum.
lines.zh: 萨莉：谢谢妈妈。

lines.en: Mum: I'm sure you can be good friends again very soon.
lines.zh: 妈妈：我相信你们很快又能成为好朋友。

title: Start up: Lingling's basketball test（日记）
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Start up U4 A better me

lines.en: Thursday, 11 October
lines.zh: 10月11日 星期四

lines.en: Our school's going to have a girls' basketball team. Amy and I want to join. We're going to have the test tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我们学校要成立一支女子篮球队。我和艾米想加入。我们明天要参加选拔测试。

lines.en: Friday, 12 October
lines.zh: 10月12日 星期五

lines.en: Amy is in. But I am out. I am very sad.
lines.zh: 艾米入选了，可我落选了。我很难过。

lines.en: Sunday, 14 October
lines.zh: 10月14日 星期日

lines.en: Amy is so kind. She comes to play basketball with me. I'm going to work hard. I can make it next time.
lines.zh: 艾米真好，她过来陪我一起打篮球。我打算努力练习，下次一定能成功。

lines.en: Friday, 26 October
lines.zh: 10月26日 星期五

lines.en: There's going to be a test again. I'm still not sure. But I'm going to try again.
lines.zh: 又要测试了。我还是没把握，但我打算再试一次。

lines.en: Sunday, 28 October
lines.zh: 10月28日 星期日

lines.en: I'm in! I'm so happy. I'm going to play with Amy and my other friends!
lines.zh: 我入选了！我太开心了。我要和艾米还有其他朋友一起打球啦！

title: Speed up: 鲁迅刻"早"（迟到的少年）
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Speed up U4 A better me（Story time）

lines.en: My mornings are always busy. My father is ill, but my family has little money. So before school, I have to sell things. With the money, I go to buy medicine for my father. It's a long way, and sometimes there are a lot of people.
lines.zh: 我的早晨总是很忙碌。我父亲病了，可家里没什么钱。所以上学前，我得先去卖东西。用换来的钱，我去给父亲买药。路很远，有时人又特别多。

lines.en: This morning, there are too many people. I'm worried. I hurry to school, but I'm still late. I run into the classroom and my teacher is there.
lines.zh: 今天早上人太多了。我很着急。我匆匆赶到学校，可还是迟到了。我跑进教室，老师就在那儿。

lines.en: He is unhappy with me. "Don't be late again," he says. I feel sad. I sit at my desk and cut a word into it. I'm not going to be late again.
lines.zh: 他对我很不满。"别再迟到了，"他说。我很难过。我坐到座位上，在桌面上刻了一个字。我再也不迟到了。

title: 听力脚本 Activity 3: Julia Hawkins 的故事
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上听力脚本U4（Activity 3）

lines.en: Dad: I'm going to go swimming. Do you want to come, Billy?
lines.zh: 爸爸：我要去游泳。比利，你想一起来吗？

lines.en: Billy: No, thanks, Dad. I'm afraid of water. I don't think I can do it well.
lines.zh: 比利：不了，谢谢爸爸。我怕水，我觉得我游不好。

lines.en: Dad: Oh dear. You should have a try.
lines.zh: 爸爸：哎呀，你应该试一试。

lines.en: Billy: Well, I'm not sure…
lines.zh: 比利：嗯，我没把握……

lines.en: Dad: Let me tell you the story of Julia Hawkins. She starts running after her 100th birthday. And she sets the world record for her age group in the 100-metre run.
lines.zh: 爸爸：我给你讲讲朱莉娅·霍金斯的故事。她过了100岁生日后开始跑步，还创造了她年龄组100米跑的世界纪录。

lines.en: Billy: Wow, she's amazing!
lines.zh: 比利：哇，她太厉害了！

lines.en: Dad: That's right. At 105, she runs the 100 metres in 1 minute and 2.95 seconds.
lines.zh: 爸爸：没错。105岁时，她用1分2.95秒跑完了100米。

lines.en: Billy: She's so cool! I should try new things, like her.
lines.zh: 比利：她太酷了！我应该像她一样尝试新事物。

lines.en: Dad: Great! Just start today.
lines.zh: 爸爸：好！今天就开始吧。

lines.en: Billy: OK, I'm in. Let's go!
lines.zh: 比利：好，我加入。走吧！

title: Start up: What will this robot do?
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Start up U5 Look into the future

lines.en: Daming: This robot is so cool!
lines.zh: 大明：这个机器人太酷了！

lines.en: Dad: I still need some time to get it to work. It will help people a lot.
lines.zh: 爸爸：我还得花点时间让它运转起来。它会帮人们很多忙。

lines.en: Daming: What will it do for people?
lines.zh: 大明：它会为人们做什么？

lines.en: Dad: A lot of things.
lines.zh: 爸爸：很多事情。

lines.en: Daming: Will it do our chores?
lines.zh: 大明：它会帮我们做家务吗？

lines.en: Dad: Yes. We will have more free time.
lines.zh: 爸爸：会。我们就会有更多空闲时间。

lines.en: Daming: Great. Will it take care of pets?
lines.zh: 大明：太好了。它会照顾宠物吗？

lines.en: Dad: Yes, it will keep an eye on the pets all day.
lines.zh: 爸爸：会，它会整天照看宠物。

lines.en: Daming: Will it play with us?
lines.zh: 大明：它会陪我们玩吗？

lines.en: Dad: Yes, it will know all kinds of games and sports.
lines.zh: 爸爸：会，它懂得各种各样的游戏和运动。

lines.en: Daming: Then we'll have a lot of fun. Well… will it do my homework?
lines.zh: 大明：那我们就会玩得很开心。呃……它会帮我做作业吗？

lines.en: Dad: No, it won't!
lines.zh: 爸爸：不会！

title: Speed up: Cities of the future
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Speed up U5 Look into the future

lines.en: This city will be under the sea. People will live in glass balls. Sea animals will be all around the houses. There will be special farms under the sea. A special glass box will take people up to the land. It will go very fast! Life under the sea will be clean, beautiful and interesting!
lines.zh: 这座城市将建在海底。人们会住在玻璃球里，海洋动物就在房子四周。海底会有特别的农场。一个特殊的玻璃舱会把人们送上陆地，速度非常快！海底的生活将会干净、美丽又有趣！

lines.en: This city will be on the moon. It will be a very different place then. Plants there will grow very big. People will make houses under them. They won't need to worry about food at all. People will put on special shoes to fly around. They will celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival right on the moon!
lines.zh: 这座城市将建在月球上。那时它会是一个非常不同的地方。那里的植物会长得非常高大，人们在植物下面盖房子。他们完全不必担心食物。人们会穿上特制的鞋子飞来飞去。他们还会就在月球上庆祝中秋节！

title: 听力脚本 Activity 3: Food in the future
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上听力脚本U5（Activity 3）

lines.en: Prof Green: Today, we are going to talk about food in the future. Scientists are always trying new ways to make food. I will share two of them with you.
lines.zh: 格林教授：今天我们来谈谈未来的食物。科学家一直在尝试制作食物的新方法。我给大家介绍两种。

lines.en: One is using 3-D printing to make food. People will make biscuits, chocolate, pizza and bread with it. It can make the food into any shape.
lines.zh: 一种是用3D打印制作食物。人们会用它做饼干、巧克力、披萨和面包，还能把食物做成任何形状。

lines.en: The other way is making a pill. Some people think we won't need to eat food in the future. The pill can give people all the things the body needs. In this way, they will have more free time for other activities. Do you want to have a try?
lines.zh: 另一种方法是做一粒药丸。有些人认为未来我们不需要吃饭，药丸能提供身体所需的一切营养。这样，人们就有更多空闲时间去做别的事。你想试一试吗？

title: Start up: A special Mid-Autumn Festival（动物园做月饼）
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Start up U6 Enjoy the festivals

lines.en: Daming: The Mid-Autumn Festival is coming. Let's make mooncakes for the animals at the zoo!
lines.zh: 大明：中秋节快到了。我们去动物园给动物们做月饼吧！

lines.en: Sam, Amy & Lingling: OK! Great idea!
lines.zh: 萨姆、艾米、玲玲：好！好主意！

lines.en: Zookeeper: Hello, children! What mooncakes are you going to make?
lines.zh: 饲养员：孩子们好！你们打算做什么月饼？

lines.en: Sam: I'm going to make meat mooncakes for the tigers.
lines.zh: 萨姆：我要给老虎做肉馅月饼。

lines.en: Lingling: I'm going to make bamboo mooncakes for the pandas.
lines.zh: 玲玲：我要给熊猫做竹子月饼。

lines.en: Sam: How about you, Amy?
lines.zh: 萨姆：艾米，你呢？

lines.en: Amy: I'm going to make mooncakes for the giraffes. I'll use leaves and carrots.
lines.zh: 艾米：我要给长颈鹿做月饼，用树叶和胡萝卜。

lines.en: Sam: And Daming?
lines.zh: 萨姆：大明呢？

lines.en: Daming: I want to make banana mooncakes for the elephants.
lines.zh: 大明：我想给大象做香蕉月饼。

lines.en: Sam: They will be very big!
lines.zh: 萨姆：那些月饼会非常大！

lines.en: Daming: They love our mooncakes!
lines.zh: 大明：它们会喜欢我们的月饼的！

lines.en: Zookeeper: Thank you, children! It's a happy Mid-Autumn Festival for the animals! And Happy Mid-Autumn Festival to you, too!
lines.zh: 饲养员：谢谢孩子们！这是动物们快乐的中秋节！也祝你们中秋节快乐！

title: Speed up: Barbapapa's Christmas tree
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Speed up U6 Enjoy the festivals（Story time）

lines.en: Christmas is coming! But Dad, we haven't got a Christmas tree.
lines.zh: 圣诞节就要到了！可是爸爸，我们还没有圣诞树。

lines.en: I'll go to the forest and get us a tree.
lines.zh: 我去森林里给我们弄一棵树回来。

lines.en: Please don't cut down this tree. It's our home.
lines.zh: 请别砍这棵树，它是我们的家。

lines.en: This one is good. This one is good, too. Please don't.
lines.zh: 这棵不错，这棵也不错。请不要砍。

lines.en: Why? You don't live in a tree.
lines.zh: 为什么？你又不住在树上。

lines.en: But I live in the forest. Animals here need these trees.
lines.zh: 可我住在森林里，这里的动物需要这些树。

lines.en: I see. You're right.
lines.zh: 我明白了，你说得对。

lines.en: The children are waiting at home. Oh! I have an idea!
lines.zh: 孩子们正在家里等。哦！我有个主意！

lines.en: Merry Christmas, everyone! Dad, the Christmas tree is great! No one will have a tree like this. We love it, Dad!
lines.zh: 大家圣诞快乐！爸爸，这棵圣诞树真棒！没人会有这样一棵树。我们爱它，爸爸！

title: 听力脚本 Activity 3: 世界各地过新年
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上听力脚本U6（Activity 3）

lines.en: Interviewer: New Year's Eve's coming. How are children from around the world celebrating it? Let's ask some of them. Hello, Xiaoman. How are you going to celebrate New Year in China?
lines.zh: 记者：新年前夜就要到了。世界各地的孩子是怎样庆祝的？我们来问问他们。你好，小满。你打算在中国怎样过新年？

lines.en: Xiaoman: I'm going to Xi'an with my parents. We're going to listen to the New Year's bell under the Bell Tower.
lines.zh: 小满：我要和父母去西安。我们打算在钟楼下面听新年钟声。

lines.en: Interviewer: Hi Charlie. How are you going to celebrate New Year in the UK?
lines.zh: 记者：你好，查理。你打算在英国怎样过新年？

lines.en: Charlie: I'm going to my friend's house. We'll have a party. At 12 am, we will share warm wishes with each other.
lines.zh: 查理：我要去朋友家，我们会办个派对。午夜12点，我们会互相送上温暖的祝福。

lines.en: Interviewer: Hi Maria. How are you going to celebrate New Year in Spain?
lines.zh: 记者：你好，玛丽亚。你打算在西班牙怎样过新年？

lines.en: Maria: I'm going to have dinner with my family. We will eat 12 grapes at 12 am. We think it will bring us luck in the new year.
lines.zh: 玛丽亚：我要和家人吃晚餐。午夜12点我们会吃12颗葡萄，我们认为这会给新的一年带来好运。

lines.en: Interviewer: And what about you, Daniel? How are you going to celebrate New Year's Eve in Australia?
lines.zh: 记者：那你呢，丹尼尔？你打算在澳大利亚怎样过新年前夜？

lines.en: Daniel: I'm going to the Sydney Harbour Bridge to watch the fireworks.
lines.zh: 丹尼尔：我要去悉尼海港大桥看烟花。

title: Start up 对话：夏令营的成长
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下知识清单+联网复核整理（非教材逐字原文）

lines.en: Tom: Did you enjoy the summer camp, Lily?
lines.zh: 汤姆：莉莉，夏令营玩得开心吗？

lines.en: Lily: Yes! At first, I was very nervous and tired.
lines.zh: 莉莉：开心！起初我非常紧张，也很累。

lines.en: Tom: Why? You were away from home for two weeks.
lines.zh: 汤姆：为什么？你离家两周呢。

lines.en: Lily: I missed my parents. But I made many new friends.
lines.zh: 莉莉：我想爸爸妈妈，但我交了很多新朋友。

lines.en: Tom: Could you swim before?
lines.zh: 汤姆：你以前会游泳吗？

lines.en: Lily: No. At first, I couldn't swim at all.
lines.zh: 莉莉：不会。起初我根本不会游。

lines.en: Tom: How did you learn?
lines.zh: 汤姆：你是怎么学会的？

lines.en: Lily: The teacher taught me every day. By the end of the camp, I got much better.
lines.zh: 莉莉：老师每天教我。到夏令营结束时，我游得好多了。

lines.en: Tom: That's wonderful. Were you sad when the camp ended?
lines.zh: 汤姆：太棒了。夏令营结束时你难过吗？

lines.en: Lily: A little. But now I know I can do many things by myself.
lines.zh: 莉莉：有一点。但现在我知道很多事我能自己做。

lines.en: Tom: You grew up a lot this summer!
lines.zh: 汤姆：这个夏天你成长了不少！

title: 句型范例：At first... By the end of...
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下知识清单+联网复核整理（非教材逐字原文）

lines.en: Last summer, I was eight years old. I joined a swimming training class.
lines.zh: 去年夏天，我八岁，参加了一个游泳训练班。

lines.en: At first, I was very nervous. I couldn't swim at all, and I was afraid of water.
lines.zh: 起初我非常紧张，根本不会游泳，还怕水。

lines.en: I practiced hard every day. My teacher helped me a lot.
lines.zh: 我每天努力练习，老师帮了我很多。

lines.en: By the end of the class, I could swim 20 meters alone.
lines.zh: 到课程结束时，我能独自游20米了。

lines.en: It was an unforgettable growing-up moment. I became brave and confident.
lines.zh: 那是一个难忘的成长瞬间，我变得勇敢而自信。

title: Start up 对话：小小的善举
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下知识清单+联网复核整理（非教材逐字原文）

lines.en: Ms Li: What did you do last Saturday, Daming?
lines.zh: 李老师：大明，上周六你做了什么？

lines.en: Daming: I helped an old man cross the street.
lines.zh: 大明：我帮一位老人过了马路。

lines.en: Ms Li: Good for you! Amy, did you help anyone?
lines.zh: 李老师：你真棒！艾米，你帮助别人了吗？

lines.en: Amy: Yes. An old lady carried my heavy bag at first. I felt sorry, so I helped her carry it.
lines.zh: 艾米：帮了。一开始是一位老奶奶帮我拎重袋子，我过意不去，就帮她拎了。

lines.en: Sam: I saw a little boy who couldn't find his mum. I helped him find the way.
lines.zh: 萨姆：我看见一个找不到妈妈的小男孩，帮他找到了路。

lines.en: Ms Li: You all did kind things. Helping others makes us happy.
lines.zh: 李老师：你们都做了好事。帮助他人让我们快乐。

lines.en: Lingling: We should be kind to people around us.
lines.zh: 玲玲：我们应该善待身边的人。

lines.en: Ms Li: Exactly. A small kind act can make someone's day.
lines.zh: 李老师：没错。一个小小的善举能让人开心一整天。

title: 句型范例：helped sb. (to) do sth.
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下知识清单+联网复核整理（非教材逐字原文）

lines.en: Last weekend, we went to the care home. We read books to the old people and helped them clean their rooms.
lines.zh: 上周末我们去了敬老院。我们给老人读书，帮他们打扫房间。

lines.en: The old people were very happy, and we felt warm and meaningful.
lines.zh: 老人们非常开心，我们心里温暖又有意义。

lines.en: We took photos and will make a photo album for them.
lines.zh: 我们拍了照片，要为他们做一本相册。

lines.en: Helping others is warm, and it makes the world a better place.
lines.zh: 帮助别人是温暖的，它让世界变得更美好。

title: Start up 对话：图书馆日
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下知识清单+联网复核整理（非教材逐字原文）

lines.en: Lingling: Did you also have library day when you were young, Ms Li?
lines.zh: 玲玲：李老师，您小时候也有图书馆日吗？

lines.en: Ms Li: Yes, we did. Every Friday afternoon, we went to the library.
lines.zh: 李老师：有。每周五下午我们都去图书馆。

lines.en: Daming: Were there many books in your school library?
lines.zh: 大明：你们学校图书馆书多吗？

lines.en: Ms Li: Not many. But we read every book we could find.
lines.zh: 李老师：不多。但我们把能找到的书都读了。

lines.en: Sam: What kind of books do you like best?
lines.zh: 萨姆：你最喜欢哪种书？

lines.en: Sam: I like storybooks best. My favourite book is Harry Potter.
lines.zh: 萨姆：我最喜欢故事书，我最爱的书是《哈利·波特》。

lines.en: Lingling: I like science books. They tell us how the world works.
lines.zh: 玲玲：我喜欢科学书，它们告诉我们世界是如何运转的。

lines.en: Amy: Shall we borrow some books today?
lines.zh: 艾米：我们今天借些书好吗？

lines.en: Ms Li: Books open a whole new world to you.
lines.zh: 李老师：书会为你们打开一个全新的世界。

title: 句型范例：书籍类型与 World Book Day
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下知识清单+联网复核整理（非教材逐字原文）

lines.en: World Book Day is on 23 April every year. It's a day to show our love of books and reading.
lines.zh: 世界读书日在每年4月23日，是表达我们对书籍和阅读之爱的日子。

lines.en: Children celebrate it in many fun ways. They read their favourite books, dress up as book characters, act out their favourite stories and make bookmarks for family and friends.
lines.zh: 孩子们用许多有趣的方式庆祝：读自己喜欢的书、装扮成书中角色、表演最喜欢的故事，还给亲友做书签。

lines.en: There are many types of books: history books, adventure fiction, fantasy stories and picture books.
lines.zh: 书有很多种类：历史书、历险小说、幻想故事和图画书。

lines.en: All the activities make reading more interesting.
lines.zh: 所有这些活动都让阅读变得更有趣。

title: Start up 对话：食物的历史
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下知识清单+联网复核整理（非教材逐字原文）

lines.en: Ms Li: Did people eat dumplings long ago?
lines.zh: 李老师：很久以前人们吃饺子吗？

lines.en: Daming: Yes. The ancient dumpling found in Xinjiang dates back to the Tang Dynasty.
lines.zh: 大明：吃。在新疆发现的古代饺子可以追溯到唐朝。

lines.en: Ms Li: How did dumplings come to Xinjiang?
lines.zh: 李老师：饺子是怎么传到新疆的？

lines.en: Amy: People brought them along the Silk Road. It was a long trade road.
lines.zh: 艾米：人们沿着丝绸之路把它带过去的，那是一条漫长的商路。

lines.en: Ms Li: Was Xinjiang an important trade centre?
lines.zh: 李老师：新疆曾是重要的贸易中心吗？

lines.en: Sam: Yes, it was. People traded food, silk and tea there.
lines.zh: 萨姆：是的。人们在那里交易食物、丝绸和茶叶。

lines.en: Ms Li: Did people eat mooncakes in the Tang Dynasty?
lines.zh: 李老师：唐朝的人吃月饼吗？

lines.en: Daming: Yes, they did. Mooncakes are a symbol of the Mid-Autumn Festival.
lines.zh: 大明：吃。月饼是中秋节的象征。

lines.en: Lingling: Food history is really interesting!
lines.zh: 玲玲：食物的历史真有趣！

lines.en: Ms Li: Yes. Food carries the stories of our people.
lines.zh: 李老师：是啊，食物承载着我们民族的故事。

title: 句型范例：date back to / in the shape of
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下知识清单+联网复核整理（非教材逐字原文）

lines.en: Xinjiang was an important place on the ancient Silk Road. It was near the border between China and other countries, so people from East and West met there for trade.
lines.zh: 新疆是古丝绸之路上的重要地点。它靠近中国与其他国家的边境，东西方的人都在那里贸易。

lines.en: The ancient dumpling found there is in the shape of a new moon and looks just like the dumplings we eat today.
lines.zh: 在那里发现的古代饺子呈新月形，看起来和我们今天吃的饺子一模一样。

lines.en: Fan Jinshi spent her life protecting Dunhuang's art. We should learn from her and protect our history.
lines.zh: 樊锦诗一生守护敦煌艺术，我们应向她学习，保护我们的历史。

title: Start up 对话：侦探故事
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下知识清单+联网复核整理（非教材逐字原文）

lines.en: Sam: Read this story! A thief stole many jewels from the palace.
lines.zh: 萨姆：读这个故事！一个小偷从宫殿偷走了很多珠宝。

lines.en: Amy: What did he do next?
lines.zh: 艾米：他接下来做了什么？

lines.en: Sam: He ran away and wrote a letter to his wife.
lines.zh: 萨姆：他逃走了，给妻子写了一封信。

lines.en: Lingling: Why did he write the letter?
lines.zh: 玲玲：他为什么写信？

lines.en: Sam: He wanted to tell her where the jewels were.
lines.zh: 萨姆：他想告诉她珠宝藏在哪里。

lines.en: Amy: But the police got the letter first.
lines.zh: 艾米：可警察先拿到了信。

lines.en: Daming: How did the detective solve the problem? She read the letter carefully.
lines.zh: 大明：侦探是怎么解决问题的？她仔细读了那封信。

lines.en: Lingling: The letter had a secret message. We can work out the message.
lines.zh: 玲玲：信里有一条秘密信息，我们能解开它。

lines.en: Amy: Did the police find the jewels?
lines.zh: 艾米：警察找到珠宝了吗？

lines.en: Daming: Yes. They didn't give the letter to his wife. They followed the clues.
lines.zh: 大明：找到了。他们没有把信给他妻子，而是顺着线索追查。

title: 句型范例：use...to... / to do 表目的
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下知识清单+联网复核整理（非教材逐字原文）

lines.en: One night, a thief stole many jewels from a big house. The next morning, a detective came to look for clues.
lines.zh: 一天夜里，一个小偷从一座大房子偷走很多珠宝。第二天早上，一位侦探来寻找线索。

lines.en: He walked around the house and looked carefully. He found a letter under the table.
lines.zh: 他绕着房子走，仔细查看，在桌子下面发现了一封信。

lines.en: The detective read the first letters of each word. They spelled a word: BRIDGE. It meant the old bridge!
lines.zh: 侦探读出每个单词的首字母，拼出一个词：BRIDGE（桥），指那座旧桥！

lines.en: The police waited near the bridge. When the thief came to get the jewels, they caught him.
lines.zh: 警察在桥附近守候。小偷来取珠宝时，他们抓住了他。

lines.en: If you look carefully, you can work out many problems!
lines.zh: 只要仔细观察，你就能解决很多问题！

title: Start up 对话：家乡的变化
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下知识清单+联网复核整理（非教材逐字原文）

lines.en: Daming: Last summer, we left Beijing in the morning and got to Xi'an in time for lunch.
lines.zh: 大明：去年夏天，我们早上离开北京，及时赶到西安吃午饭。

lines.en: Amy: Wow! How did you get there so fast?
lines.zh: 艾米：哇！你们怎么这么快就到了？

lines.en: Daming: We went by high-speed train. It was very fast.
lines.zh: 大明：我们坐高铁去的，非常快。

lines.en: Amy: Did you see any changes in Xi'an?
lines.zh: 艾米：你们看到西安的变化了吗？

lines.en: Daming: Yes. Now the streets are still full of bikes, but most are shared bikes.
lines.zh: 大明：看到了。现在街上仍然满是自行车，但大多是共享单车。

lines.en: Amy: What did Grandpa say?
lines.zh: 艾米：爷爷怎么说？

lines.en: Daming: Grandpa told me the streets of China were full of bikes 30 years ago.
lines.zh: 大明：爷爷告诉我，30年前中国的街上满是自行车。

lines.en: Amy: Did people have many roads before?
lines.zh: 艾米：以前路很多吗？

lines.en: Daming: No. In the past, the journey to school was hard and dangerous.
lines.zh: 大明：不多。过去上学的路程艰难又危险。

lines.en: Amy: Our country changes so fast!
lines.zh: 艾米：我们国家变化真快！

lines.en: Daming: Yes. Many people work hard to make it more beautiful.
lines.zh: 大明：是啊，很多人努力让它变得更美。

title: 句型范例：过去与现在对比
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下知识清单+联网复核整理（非教材逐字原文）

lines.en: Thirty years ago, life was very different. People lived in small houses, and there were not many cars. The streets were full of bikes.
lines.zh: 三十年前，生活非常不同。人们住小房子，汽车也不多，街上满是自行车。

lines.en: But today, everything is different. There are lots of tall buildings and wide roads. People can travel by high-speed train in hours.
lines.zh: 但如今一切都变了。有许多高楼和宽阔的马路，人们几小时就能坐高铁到达远方。

lines.en: Grandpa told me some young people gave up a good life in the city to do something for their hometown.
lines.zh: 爷爷告诉我，有些年轻人放弃城里的美好生活，为家乡做贡献。

lines.en: After many years, the hills became green with millions of trees. Changes bring us a better life.
lines.zh: 许多年后，山上长出数百万棵树，变得绿油油。变化带给我们更好的生活。

title: Start up · Spend or save（教材P4，课文拆解练习U1）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上课文拆解练习U1（Start up，教材P4真实语段）

lines.en: Sam and Amy get pocket money every week. Amy always saves her money. Sam always spends his.
lines.zh: 萨姆和艾米每周都领到零花钱。艾米总是把钱存起来，萨姆总是把钱花掉。

lines.en: Sam: How much is the robot?
lines.zh: 萨姆：这个机器人多少钱？

lines.en: Shopkeeper 1: It's 35 yuan.
Sam: I'll take it.
lines.zh: 萨姆：我要了。

lines.en: Sam: I want two ice creams. How much are they?
lines.zh: 萨姆：我要两个冰淇淋。多少钱？

lines.en: Shopkeeper 2: They're eight yuan.
lines.zh: 店主2：8元。

lines.en: Sam: Here you are.
lines.zh: 萨姆：给你钱。

lines.en: The School Reading Week is coming. Amy has many new books for the children's home. But Sam has only two coins.
lines.zh: 学校阅读周就要到了。艾米为儿童之家准备了许多新书，可萨姆只有两枚硬币。

lines.en: Amy: Hi, these books are for you!
lines.zh: 艾米：嗨，这些书是给你们的！

lines.en: All: Thanks, Amy!
lines.zh: 大家：谢谢你，艾米！

lines.en: Sam: I'll save my money for the right things from now on.
lines.zh: 萨姆：从现在起，我要把钱存起来用在该用的地方。

title: Speed up · The golden touch（教材P6-7故事）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF Speed up《The golden touch》（真实故事）

lines.en: Long long ago, there was a king called Midas. He loved gold very much. One day he met an old man. The old man said, "Do you have a wish? I can make it come true." "I wish for a golden touch," said Midas. "I want to turn everything to gold!"
lines.zh: 很久很久以前，有一位名叫迈达斯的国王，他非常热爱黄金。一天，他遇见一位老人。老人说：“你有愿望吗？我能让它实现。”“我希望有点石成金的本领，”迈达斯说，“我要把一切都变成黄金！”

lines.en: Midas turned everything around him to gold. He was happy. Then Midas was hungry, but all his food also turned to gold. His daughter came in. Midas took her hand. She turned to gold, too! Midas was very sad. He cried, "I don't want gold now. I want food. I want my daughter back." The old man smiled, "Just remember, gold isn't everything."
lines.zh: 迈达斯把身边的一切都变成了黄金，他很开心。后来他饿了，可所有食物也变成了黄金。女儿走进来，迈达拉住她的手，她也变成了黄金！迈达斯非常伤心，哭着说：“我现在不要黄金了，我要食物，我要我的女儿回来。”老人笑着说：“记住，黄金不是万能的。”

title: In focus · How much 问价句型（教材P5）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF In focus（U1真实句型）

lines.en: —How much is the robot?
lines.zh: ——这个机器人多少钱？

lines.en: —It's 35 yuan.
—How much are the ice creams?
lines.zh: ——这些冰淇淋多少钱？

lines.en: —They're eight yuan.
I get pocket money every week. I'll save my money for the right things from now on.
lines.zh: 我每周领到零花钱。从现在起，我要把钱存起来用在该用的地方。

title: Start up · How should I eat an apple?（教材P16）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF Start up（U2真实语段，比较级/观点）

lines.en: Tom: Look at the food! What should I eat first? Mm… I want an apple.
lines.zh: 汤姆：看看这些食物！我该先吃什么？嗯……我想吃个苹果。

lines.en: Amy: Apples are good, but don't eat the peel. Apple peel is dirty.
lines.zh: 艾米：苹果是好东西，可别吃皮，苹果皮脏。

lines.en: Lingling: But apples with the peel are healthier.
lines.zh: 玲玲：可是带皮的苹果更健康。

lines.en: Sam: Apples with no peel taste better.
lines.zh: 萨姆：削了皮的苹果尝起来更好。

lines.en: Daming: Why not just eat it with the peel? It's easier and faster.
lines.zh: 大明：为什么不就连皮吃呢？那样更省事、更快。

lines.en: Tom: Er…
lines.zh: 汤姆：呃……

lines.en: Amy: This apple is making our picnic more interesting. We all have different ideas.
lines.zh: 艾米：这个苹果让我们的野餐更有意思了。大家各有各的想法。

title: Speed up · Crayons' letters（教材P18-19故事）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF Speed up《Crayons' letters》（真实故事）

lines.en: Duncan opens his box of colours. But he can't find his crayons. There are only letters from them.
lines.zh: 邓肯打开他的彩笔盒，却找不到蜡笔，里面只有一封封蜡笔写来的信。

lines.en: Grey: You use me to colour big animals. I'm now shorter than my friends! I want to colour smaller things.
lines.zh: 灰色：你总用我画大动物，我现在比朋友们都短了！我想画小一点的东西。

lines.en: Pink: Remember me? It's Pink and I'm angry. You never use me. Why? Boys can use the colour pink! A pink dinosaur is good, too.
lines.zh: 粉色：还记得我吗？我是粉色，我很生气。你从不使用我。男孩也能用粉色啊！一只粉色恐龙也很棒。

lines.en: Black: It's Black, and I'm unhappy. You only use me for lines. How about a black rainbow next time?
lines.zh: 黑色：我是黑色，我不开心。你只用我画线条。下次来条黑色彩虹怎么样？

lines.en: Duncan listens to them, and draws a picture they all like.
lines.zh: 邓肯听着它们的话，画了一幅大家都喜欢的画。

title: 观点与建议句型（教材P17，should/shouldn't）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF In focus（U2真实句型，should/比较级）

lines.en: In my opinion, apples with the peel are healthier.
lines.zh: 在我看来，带皮的苹果更健康。

lines.en: I don't think so. Apples with no peel taste better.
lines.zh: 我不这么认为。削了皮的苹果尝起来更好。

lines.en: You should wash the apple carefully before eating it.
lines.zh: 吃苹果前你应该把它仔细洗干净。

lines.en: You shouldn't throw the peel away.
lines.zh: 你不应该把果皮扔掉。

lines.en: Health is more important than a nice taste.
lines.zh: 健康比美味更重要。

title: Start up · Our wonderful natural world（教材P28）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF Start up（U3真实语段，最高级/度量）

lines.en: There are so many wonders on earth. We need to take care of them.
lines.zh: 地球上有许多自然奇观，我们需要爱护它们。

lines.en: Mount Qomolangma is the world's highest mountain. It was 8,848.86 metres high in 2020. And it is getting higher every year.
lines.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山。2020年它高8848.86米，而且每年还在增高。

lines.en: What is the world's biggest desert? You may say the Sahara. Well, it's not. It is the Antarctic Desert. It is over 14 million square kilometres.
lines.zh: 世界上最大的沙漠是什么？你也许会说撒哈拉，其实不是，是南极沙漠，面积超过1400万平方千米。

lines.en: The longest river in the world is the Nile. It is about 6,671 kilometres long. It runs across 11 countries.
lines.zh: 世界上最长的河是尼罗河，长约6671千米，流经11个国家。

title: Speed up · Xu Xiake（教材P30故事）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF Speed up《Xu Xiake》（真实故事）

lines.en: Xu Xiake is one of the most famous travellers in China. He was interested in nature from a young age. He read many books about famous mountains and rivers. He wanted to see them with his eyes.
lines.zh: 徐霞客是中国最著名的旅行家之一。他从小就对大自然感兴趣，读了许多名山大川的书，想亲眼去看看。

lines.en: Xu Xiake started to travel at the age of 21. He visited many places in China. He wrote about mountains and rivers, like Mount Huangshan and the Jinsha River. He travelled for about 30 years. He loved nature and always called for people to take care of nature. He said, "I went to so many wonderful places in China. I had a wonderful life."
lines.zh: 徐霞客21岁开始游历，走遍中国许多地方，写下关于山川河流的文字，如黄山、金沙江。他游历了约30年。他热爱大自然，总是呼吁人们爱护自然。他说：“我走遍了中国这么多美好的地方，我的一生很精彩。”

title: Let's explore · National parks（教材P37，拆解练习）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上课文拆解练习U3（Let's explore，教材P37真实语段）

lines.en: Sanjiangyuan National Park in China is the biggest national park in China. It has rivers, mountains, lakes and grasslands. The most famous animal here is the snow leopard.
lines.zh: 中国三江源国家公园是中国最大的国家公园，有河流、高山、湖泊和草原，这里最著名的动物是雪豹。

lines.en: Yellowstone National Park in the USA is the first national park in the USA. It has mountains, forests, lakes and hot springs. One of the most famous animals here is the black bear.
lines.zh: 美国黄石国家公园是美国第一座国家公园，有高山、森林、湖泊和温泉，这里最著名的动物之一是黑熊。

lines.en: Serengeti National Park in Tanzania is one of the most famous national parks in Africa. Every year, a lot of animals here move across the park.
lines.zh: 坦桑尼亚塞伦盖蒂国家公园是非洲最著名的国家公园之一，每年这里有大量动物迁徙穿过公园。

title: Start up · A watering bottle（教材P40）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF Start up（U4真实语段，First/Next/Then/Last步骤）

lines.en: Mum: What about our plants? We're coming back in six days.
lines.zh: 妈妈：这些植物怎么办？我们六天后才回来。

lines.en: Daming: Let me think… I'm making a watering bottle for the plants.
lines.zh: 大明：让我想想……我在给植物做一个浇水瓶。

lines.en: Mum: How?
lines.zh: 妈妈：怎么做？

lines.en: Daming: First, make a small hole in the middle of the bottle cap. Next, cut off the bottom. Then, put water in the bottle. Last, put it next to the plant. It's watering the plant now!
lines.zh: 大明：首先，在瓶盖中间钻一个小洞。接着，剪掉瓶底。然后，往瓶里装水。最后，把它放在植物旁边，它现在就在给植物浇水啦！

lines.en: Mum: Clever boy! When we are back, the plants are fine. My bottles worked!
lines.zh: 妈妈：聪明的孩子！我们回来时，植物都好好的。我的瓶子成功了！

title: Speed up · Lu Ban and the umbrella（教材P42故事）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF Speed up《Lu Ban and the umbrella》（真实故事）

lines.en: Grandpa: It's raining. Take an umbrella.
lines.zh: 爷爷：下雨了，带把伞。

lines.en: Lingling: Grandpa, who first got the idea of making an umbrella?
lines.zh: 玲玲：爷爷，是谁最先想出做伞的主意？

lines.en: Grandpa: No one knows for sure. But stories say it was Lu Ban. One day, Lu Ban was on the way home. It rained. He thought, "What can I make to keep off the rain?" Just then, he saw a boy with a big leaf over his head. "That's a good idea!" First, he used bamboo to make the sticks. Next, he cut some cloth. Then, he put the cloth over the sticks. That was the first umbrella!
lines.zh: 爷爷：没人说得准，传说说是鲁班。一天鲁班回家路上，下起雨。他想：“我能做什么来挡雨？”就在这时，他看见一个男孩头顶一片大叶子。“好主意！”首先，他用竹子做伞骨。接着，他剪下一块布。然后，把布盖在伞骨上。这就是第一把伞！

lines.en: Lingling: Wow! Lu Ban had great ideas and clever hands!
lines.zh: 玲玲：哇！鲁班既有好点子，又有巧手！

title: Let's explore · History: The wheel（教材P49，拆解练习）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上课文拆解练习U4（Let's explore，教材P49真实语段）

lines.en: There are many world-changing inventions. We often think of things like the computer and the internet. But did you know that the wheel is also one of them? The wheel is one of the oldest inventions. Some people in China think it was Huangdi, or the Yellow Emperor, who invented the wheel. The wheel helps people solve many problems. It is an important part of so many things and makes life easier for us.
lines.zh: 有许多改变世界的发明。我们常想到电脑、互联网，可你知道轮子也是其中之一吗？轮子是最古老的发明之一。中国有些人认为是黄帝发明了轮子。轮子帮人们解决了许多问题，它是众多物品的重要组成部分，让我们的生活更便利。

title: Start up · Keep away from the flu（教材P52）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF Start up（U5真实语段，看病/should建议）

lines.en: Doctor: What's the matter?
lines.zh: 医生：怎么了？

lines.en: Lingling: I have a fever and a bad headache.
lines.zh: 玲玲：我发烧，而且头痛得厉害。

lines.en: Doctor: Let me see… Well, it looks like you have the flu. These are viruses. They can give you the flu.
lines.zh: 医生：我看看……你好像得了流感。这些是病毒，它们会让你得流感。

lines.en: Doctor: Take this medicine and get lots of sleep.
lines.zh: 医生：吃下这个药，多睡觉。

lines.en: Lingling: OK. But how can I stay away from the flu, doctor?
lines.zh: 玲玲：好的。可是医生，我怎样才能远离流感？

lines.en: Doctor: Eat healthy food and do sport. Then you'll be healthy and strong.
lines.zh: 医生：吃健康的食物，多运动，这样你就会健康强壮。

title: Speed up · Mary's eyes（教材P54故事）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF Speed up《Mary's eyes》（真实故事）

lines.en: Mary: Oh, Mum, you're here. I can't see well. Yesterday, Miss Green wrote a "3" on the blackboard. But I saw an "8"!
lines.zh: 玛丽：哦，妈妈，你在这儿。我看不清。昨天格林老师在黑板上写了个“3”，我却看成了“8”！

lines.en: Mum: Don't worry. Let's go to the doctor.
lines.zh: 妈妈：别担心，我们去看医生。

lines.en: Doctor: Mary, do you often read in dark places?
lines.zh: 医生：玛丽，你常在暗处看书吗？

lines.en: Mary: Yes, I like reading in bed at night.
lines.zh: 玛丽：是的，我喜欢晚上躺在床上看书。

lines.en: Doctor: And do you watch a lot of TV? Something is wrong with your eyes, but it's not a big problem. Do eye exercises every day. Don't read in the dark. Go out often and look far away. You should take care of your eyes.
lines.zh: 医生：那你是不是还看很多电视？你的眼睛有点问题，但不是大毛病。每天做眼保健操，别在暗处看书，常到户外远眺。你应该爱护自己的眼睛。

title: Fuel up · Let's be happy（教材P56歌谣）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF Fuel up《Let's be happy》（真实歌谣）

lines.en: A heart of glass is easy to break. It makes your world cloudy and grey.
lines.zh: 玻璃般的心易碎，会让世界阴沉灰暗。

lines.en: Let's keep our bodies healthy. Let's stay happy!
lines.zh: 让我们保持身体健康，让我们快乐常在！

lines.en: Put a smile on your face, And gladly face your day.
lines.zh: 把微笑挂在脸上，开心地面对每一天。

lines.en: Small things can make you feel great. Happy times are here to stay!
lines.zh: 小事也能让你感觉很棒，快乐时光永远相伴！

title: Start up · With us in London（教材P64，邮件）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF Start up（U6真实邮件，What/How感叹句）

lines.en: Hi Lingling! How are you now? We are all worried about your leg. Sam and Amy took us around London. What a wonderful city it is! We had a good view from the London Eye. We saw Big Ben, Buckingham Palace and Tower Bridge. We went to Tower Bridge and had a walk on its glass floor. But I was a little scared! I kept thinking about the song "London Bridge is falling down." Sam laughed and said, "Don't worry. This isn't London Bridge." We took many photos, and Bobo put you in them. Now you are here with us in London!
lines.zh: 嗨，玲玲！你现在好吗？我们都担心你的腿。萨姆和艾米带我们逛了伦敦。多棒的城市啊！我们在伦敦眼上看到了好风景，见到了大本钟、白金汉宫和塔桥。我们走上塔桥的玻璃地板，但我有点害怕！我一直想着那首《伦敦桥要倒了》。萨姆笑着说：“别担心，这不是伦敦桥。”我们拍了许多照片，博博把你也加了进去，现在你和我们一起在伦敦啦！

title: Speed up · John's travel diary（教材P66-67）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上教材PDF Speed up《John's travel diary》（真实游记）

lines.en: Sunday, 19 March: Hi there. I'm now in China. I will ride around the country. It won't be easy because China is so big! It is a beautiful and interesting place. I just want to see it with my own eyes.
lines.zh: 3月19日 星期日：大家好。我现在在中国，打算骑车环游这个国家。中国这么大，可不容易！这是个美丽又有趣的地方，我只想亲眼看看。

lines.en: Sunday, 26 March: It's very hot today. I lost my water bottle. I went to a house by the road for help. I can't speak any Chinese, but they got it! They gave me some water and asked me to stay for lunch. How lucky I am!
lines.zh: 3月26日 星期日：今天很热。我弄丢了水壶，到路边一户人家求助。我不会说中文，可他们帮我找回了！他们给我水喝，还留我吃午饭。我多幸运啊！

lines.en: Thursday, 13 April: I'm in Yunnan now. It's the Water-splashing Festival! People get together to celebrate the Dai New Year. They splash water on each other. To them, this will bring good luck to others. How lucky I am!
lines.zh: 4月13日 星期四：我现在在云南。这里是泼水节！人们聚在一起庆祝傣历新年，互相泼水。对他们来说，这会给对方带来好运。我多幸运啊！

title: Let's explore · Famous travellers（教材P73，拆解练习）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六上课文拆解练习U6（Let's explore，教材P73真实语段）

lines.en: In 138 BC, Zhang Qian travelled from Chang'an (today's Xi'an) to the west. His trips took him across huge deserts and over high mountains. His trips helped the opening of the Silk Road.
lines.zh: 公元前138年，张骞从长安（今西安）出使西域，穿越广阔沙漠、翻越高山，他的行程促成了丝绸之路的开辟。

lines.en: Marco Polo was famous for his travel on the Silk Road. He was one of the first Europeans to visit China. He came to China in 1275 and stayed for 17 years. He wrote about his exciting life in China at the time.
lines.zh: 马可·波罗因沿丝绸之路旅行而闻名，他是最早来到中国的欧洲人之一，1275年来到中国并停留17年，写下他当时在中国精彩的生活。

title: I want a hot dog, please.（点餐·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M1点餐话题）

lines.en: Waiter: Good afternoon! Can I help you?
lines.zh: 服务员：下午好！需要点什么？

lines.en: Daming: I want a hot dog, please.
lines.zh: 大明：请给我一个热狗。

lines.en: Waiter: And what do you want, Lingling?
lines.zh: 服务员：玲玲，你想要什么？

lines.en: Lingling: I want a hamburger. It looks tasty.
lines.zh: 玲玲：我要一个汉堡，它看起来很好吃。

lines.en: Waiter: Amy, what would you like?
lines.zh: 服务员：艾米，你想要点什么？

lines.en: Amy: I'd like a vegetable salad, please.
lines.zh: 艾米：请给我一份蔬菜沙拉。

lines.en: Sam: Can I have a cola too?
lines.zh: 萨姆：我还能要一杯可乐吗？

lines.en: Waiter: Sure. Anything else?
lines.zh: 服务员：当然。还要别的吗？

lines.en: Daming: How much is it all together?
lines.zh: 大明：一共多少钱？

lines.en: Waiter: The hot dog is three dollars, the hamburger four dollars, the salad five dollars, and the colas are two dollars each.
lines.zh: 服务员：热狗三美元，汉堡四美元，沙拉五美元，可乐每杯两美元。

lines.en: Daming: Let's enjoy our meal before it gets cold.
lines.zh: 大明：趁食物还没凉，我们快享用吧。

title: What do you want to eat?（点餐·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M1点餐句型）

lines.en: —What do you want to eat?
lines.zh: ——你想吃什么？

lines.en: —I want noodles and a glass of milk.
lines.zh: ——我想吃面条，再来一杯牛奶。

lines.en: —What do you want to drink?
lines.zh: ——你想喝什么？

lines.en: —Just a cup of water, please.
lines.zh: ——请来一杯水就好。

lines.en: —Here's your food. Enjoy your meal!
lines.zh: ——您的餐来了，请慢用！

lines.en: —Thank you very much.
lines.zh: ——非常感谢。

title: When are we going to eat?（be going to·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M2 be going to计划）

lines.en: Lingling: It is Sunday tomorrow. Let's have a picnic in the park.
lines.zh: 玲玲：明天是星期天，我们去公园野餐吧。

lines.en: Daming: Good idea! When are we going to eat?
lines.zh: 大明：好主意！我们打算几点吃饭？

lines.en: Lingling: We are going to eat at half past twelve.
lines.zh: 玲玲：我们打算十二点半吃饭。

lines.en: Daming: What are we going to bring?
lines.zh: 大明：我们打算带什么？

lines.en: Lingling: We are going to bring sandwiches, fruit and juice.
lines.zh: 玲玲：我们打算带三明治、水果和果汁。

lines.en: Daming: I am going to take my kite too.
lines.zh: 大明：我还打算带上风筝。

lines.en: Amy: Hello! Can I come with you?
lines.zh: 艾米：你好！我能一起去吗？

lines.en: Lingling: Of course. What are you going to bring?
lines.zh: 玲玲：当然。你打算带什么？

lines.en: Amy: I'm going to bring some cookies.
lines.zh: 艾米：我打算带一些曲奇。

lines.en: Lingling: Let's meet at the school gate at half past eleven.
lines.zh: 玲玲：我们十一点半在校门口集合。

lines.en: Daming: See you then. I can't wait!
lines.zh: 大明：到时候见，我都等不及了！

title: It will snow in Harbin.（will天气·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M2 will表将来天气）

lines.en: —What will the weather be like tomorrow?
lines.zh: ——明天天气怎么样？

lines.en: —It will be sunny and warm in Sanya.
lines.zh: ——三亚将晴朗温暖。

lines.en: —Will it rain in Beijing?
lines.zh: ——北京会下雨吗？

lines.en: —Yes, it will. It will rain in the morning.
lines.zh: ——会的，上午有雨。

lines.en: —What about Harbin?
lines.zh: ——哈尔滨呢？

lines.en: —It will snow in Harbin. It will be cold and windy.
lines.zh: ——哈尔滨会下雪，又冷又刮风。

lines.en: —Take warm clothes with you!
lines.zh: ——带上暖和的衣服！

title: The sun is shining.（现在进行时·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M3现在进行时描述照片）

lines.en: Daming: Lingling, look at the photo I took in the park. What a beautiful day! The sun is shining.
lines.zh: 大明：玲玲，看我在公园拍的照片。多美的天！太阳正照耀着。

lines.en: Lingling: Who is that under the big tree?
lines.zh: 玲玲：大树下面是谁？

lines.en: Daming: That's my grandpa. He is reading a newspaper.
lines.zh: 大明：那是我爷爷，他正在看报纸。

lines.en: Lingling: What are the cows doing near the river?
lines.zh: 玲玲：河边的奶牛在做什么？

lines.en: Daming: The cows are drinking water slowly.
lines.zh: 大明：奶牛们正慢慢地喝水。

lines.en: Lingling: And the rabbits?
lines.zh: 玲玲：那兔子呢？

lines.en: Daming: The rabbits are jumping on the grass.
lines.zh: 大明：兔子们正在草地上蹦跳。

lines.en: Lingling: Where are you in the photo?
lines.zh: 玲玲：照片里你在哪儿？

lines.en: Daming: I am playing hide-and-seek with Simon.
lines.zh: 大明：我正和西蒙玩捉迷藏。

lines.en: Lingling: Everyone looks happy.
lines.zh: 玲玲：每个人看起来都很快乐。

title: The cows are drinking water.（现在进行时·农场·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M3现在进行时）

lines.en: It is a bright Saturday morning on the farm. The sun is shining warmly. The cows are drinking water from a small river. Some ducks are swimming happily on the water. Under the apple tree, a farmer is feeding his chickens. The chickens are running around. On the grass, two little rabbits are jumping after a butterfly. Everyone is busy, but everyone is smiling.
lines.zh: 这是农场一个明媚的周六早晨。太阳温暖地照耀着。奶牛们正在一条小河边喝水。几只鸭子在水面快乐地游。苹果树下，一位农夫正在喂鸡，鸡群四处跑。草地上，两只小兔子正追着蝴蝶蹦跳。每个人都很忙，但每个人都在微笑。

title: The balloons are flying away!（进行时突发·求助·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M4进行时+Who can help me）

lines.en: Daming: Oh no! Look at the kitchen! The balloons are flying away to the ceiling!
lines.zh: 大明：哦，不！看看厨房！气球正往天花板飞！

lines.en: Lingling: And the apples are falling down the stairs!
lines.zh: 玲玲：苹果正从楼梯上滚下来！

lines.en: Daming: I was carrying them, but the bag broke.
lines.zh: 大明：我本来提着它们，可袋子破了。

lines.en: Lingling: Look! The eggs are rolling off the plate, and the water is spilling on the floor.
lines.zh: 玲玲：看！鸡蛋正从盘子里滚出来，水洒了一地。

lines.en: Daming: Mum, who can help me? I can't carry everything.
lines.zh: 大明：妈妈，谁能帮帮我？我一个人拿不了这么多。

lines.en: Lingling: Let's pick up the apples first and catch the balloons before they pop.
lines.zh: 玲玲：我们先捡苹果，趁气球没爆先抓住它们。

lines.en: Daming: This is going to take all afternoon!
lines.zh: 大明：这下得花整整一下午！

title: The apples are falling down the stairs.（进行时·凌乱·复核整理）
